The price of this protection is a process of "Boeing-ification": the erosion of innovation velocity under the twin pressures of the defense acquisition apparatus (FAR/DFARS) and Wall Street quarterly capitalism. The article concludes with a conditional forecast for the period 2026-2035: Musk's empire is likely to survive financially, but its original interplanetary ideal will be subjected to a powerful structural gravitational pull toward the role of a domesticated defense infrastructure contractor.

AI.tldr: 本文以2026年SpaceX创纪录IPO为切入点，提出一个反直觉论点：这并非财务成功的巅峰，而是马斯克在2025年与特朗普政府公开冲突后的结构性防御动作——将个人风险转化为美国经济和国防的系统性风险，从而抬高政治对手的攻击成本。文章提出"思想向量"定性框架，区分三种威胁类型，指出马斯克的"盾牌"结构只对没收/国有化有效，无法抵御监管与市值摧毁，并将以"波音化"——创新速度被国防采购体系和华尔街季度资本主义侵蚀——为代价。
AI.research_question: SpaceX 2026年创纪录IPO究竟是财务成功的巅峰，还是马斯克在政治冲突背景下的结构性防御机制？这种防御机制的有效性边界及其长期后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 主流媒体将SpaceX IPO解读为财务成功的巅峰事件，但作者观察到该事件发生在马斯克与特朗普政府2025年公开冲突之后，认为存在更深层的结构性逻辑——将个人风险系统化、政治化以寻求自我保护，这一机制此前未被系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: "思想向量"（Vector of Thought）定性分析框架：捕捉马斯克的第一性原理工程方法论（适用于确定性域的线性最优操作）与社会、生物、行为系统的非线性本质之间的错位。该框架为概念性启发工具，非封闭数学定理，"偏差角"等量仅具有定性描述意义。
AI.method: 定性分析，基于"思想向量"框架进行概念性推理，区分三种易被混淆的威胁类型（监管胁迫、征收/国有化、市值摧毁），并通过逻辑论证评估"盾牌"结构的保护边界。
AI.findings: ①马斯克构建的"盾牌"结构（通过散户和指数基金分散所有权+与"金穹"导弹防御基础设施纠缠）仅能抵御征收/国有化这一种威胁，无法抵御监管胁迫和市值摧毁；②防御代价是"波音化"过程——国防采购体系（FAR/DFARS）与华尔街季度资本主义双重压力侵蚀创新速度；③2026-2035年有条件预测：帝国财务上大概率幸存，但星际理想将受到结构性引力作用，向被驯化的国防基础设施承包商角色靠拢。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"思想向量"概念框架，用以分析工程技术思维与非线性社会系统之间的结构性错位；系统区分了三种不同性质的威胁类型（监管、征收、市值），为理解科技巨头与政治系统的博弈提供了更精细的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示了"波音化"路径对创新速度的侵蚀机制，为政策制定者和投资者理解SpaceX等深度嵌入国防体系的科技企业的长期演化提供了分析视角；揭示了将个人政治风险系统化的策略逻辑及其边界条件。

title: The Outperformance of Actively Managed Funds: Evidence from India using Panel Data Analysis
affiliations: TKM College of Arts and Science, Kollam 5

detail.title: The Outperformance of Actively Managed Funds: Evidence from India using Panel Data Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper is original conference version presented at the SEBI–NISM Research Conference 2021 and included in the conference compendium 2022. A substantially revised and extended version of this work was subsequently published as a peer-reviewed journal article.

detail.abstract: Actively managed funds are better informed than the market and widely believed for generating out performance during the market downturn. This has been tested with Jensen’s alpha, the regression intercept of CAPM-model. Lagged instrumental variables are utilized for generating conditional alpha’s, the commonly used measure of ask illed manager The relevance and the exogeneity of the instruments have tested and the weak instruments were removed. The study mainly focused on the overall performance of Indian Mutual Funds during the pandemic period using panel data methodology. The data for NAV’s were retrieved from the website of AMFI for seven months from March 2020 to September 2020. The results of the Haussman Test found that the individual effects are fixed, hence applied LSDV estimators in addition to the sys-GMM estimator. The intercept obtained from both models were used as the measure of managers ability to out performance the market. The study emphasised the needed for applying conditional alphas over the unconditional performance. The results indicate that the managers do not exhibit any superior ability to assimilate information differently than the passively managed benchmark. The study rejected the popular hypothesis of out performance during the crisis period.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用条件alpha模型（CAPM回归截距项），采用面板数据方法（LSDV和sys-GMM估计量），检验了2020年3月至9月疫情期间印度主动管理型共同基金的表现。结果表明，基金经理并不具备优于被动管理基准的超额能力，推翻了"危机期间主动基金能跑赢市场"的普遍假设。
AI.research_question: 疫情期间，印度主动管理型共同基金是否表现出优于市场的超额收益能力？
AI.motivation: 市场普遍认为主动管理型基金在市场低迷时期能够凭借信息优势跑赢大盘，但这一假设缺乏严格检验。特别是新冠疫情这一极端市场危机为检验基金经理"危机选股能力"提供了自然实验窗口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的Jensen's alpha；条件alpha（conditional alpha）与无条件alpha（unconditional alpha）的区分；有效市场假说；基金经理信息优势理论。
AI.method: 面板数据方法论；Hausman检验确定固定效应；LSDV（最小二乘虚拟变量）估计量；系统GMM（sys-GMM）估计量；使用滞后工具变量生成条件alpha；对工具变量进行了相关性和外生性检验，排除了弱工具变量。
AI.findings: 基金经理在与被动管理基准相比时，并未展现出任何卓越的信息处理能力；拒绝了"危机期间主动基金能够跑赢市场"的流行假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了有效市场假说在极端危机情境下的适用性；强调了使用条件alpha（而非无条件alpha）评估基金经理能力的必要性；为工具变量法在基金绩效评估中的应用提供了方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者而言，疫情期间选择主动管理型基金未必能获得超额收益，被动投资策略在危机中同样有效；对基金公司而言，需要反思主动管理费率的合理性；对监管层而言，为基金信息披露和投资者保护提供了实证依据。

reference: Journal of Corporation Law, Volume 51, No. 4 (2026)
title: Strategy's Bitcoin Treasury Model: Corporate Omphaloskepsis, Polypharmacy of Risk, and Shareholder and Societal Welfare
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - School of Law

detail.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Treasury Model: Corporate Omphaloskepsis, Polypharmacy of Risk, and Shareholder and Societal Welfare

keywords: speculation; stock price vs. intrinsic value

contentType.other: article accepted for publication by Journal of Corporation Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Corporation Law, Volume 51, No. 4 (2026)

detail.abstract:
Strategy Inc (MSTR), formerly MicroStrategy, is the first and largest “bitcoin treasury company” (BTCo). MSTR essentially produces no goods or services and generates no operating cash flow. Yet by early 2025, its shares rose 27-fold in under five years, a 110% annualized return. Firms worldwide began imitating its BTCo model. With 4% of all bitcoins, MSTR is the largest known institutional holder. In 2025 it issued more equity capital than any other U.S. company.

This is the first academic work on the model’s law and economics. It introduces the concept of “corporate omphaloskepsis” to help capture the model’s ends and means, and that of “polypharmacy of financial risk” to frame some key investor consequences. MSTR’s core functioning is striking. Where the animating engine of ordinary public companies rests on producing goods and services, MSTR’s rests largely on repeatedly issuing shares at a premium over the per share net asset value (NAV) of its bitcoin holdings, with proceeds deployed to buy more. The focus is on the issuances/purchases, on sustaining and, ideally, expanding the premium, and on promoting bitcoin.

I term this “corporate omphaloskepsis”: the firm gazes inward at two numbers—bitcoin’s price and its share price premium—with the outside world mattering only insofar as it moves them. As long as a premium exists, each issuance is accretive to NAV—an internal arbitrage in which new shareholders subsidize existing ones.

Beyond an analytical framework, the Article makes three contributions. First, it shows that MSTR’s core ends and means are unique. Its ends are an extreme “financialization” of the shareholder wealth maximization posited by corporate law and finance theory. Its essential means depart even more: the animating engine runs on share price premiums and bitcoin purchases. Sustaining the premium also requires other sui generis tasks: e.g., amplifying bitcoin exposure via capital structure, promoting bitcoin, and catering to investor heterogeneity with unusual intensity. The Article explores complexities in ascertaining the premium at which the engine functions, including competing methods for calculating “mNAV” (multiple of share price to per share NAV).

Second, the Article identifies idiosyncratic shareholder protection and societal welfare concerns. Shareholders face a “polypharmacy of financial risk” more complex to assess than its medical namesake. The interactions among a wide range of hazards—bitcoin’s volatility, MSTR’s status as a bitcoin whale, the amplified bitcoin exposure, and the substantive, process, and regulatory risks associated with its engine—are reflexively coupled. The composite risk exposure may be closer to Knightian uncertainty than calculable risk. MSTR’s retail ownership and messaging on diversification exacerbate concerns. Societal issues loom. MSTR advocacy that firms redirect securities issuance proceeds from product development to bitcoin holdings cuts against the innovation on which modern economic dynamism rests.

Third, the Article proposes responses. They are not predicated on MSTR or bitcoin being Ponzi-like, meme stock-like, or otherwise suspect. Instead, they are based on a principle of neutrality between the MSTR model and the ordinary public company model. Existing private ordering and federal disclosure rules have inadvertently favored the former; we propose certain remedial steps. As for private ordering, the MSCI Global Investable Market and Nasdaq-100 indexes—primarily meant to capture operating companies—nonetheless include MSTR due largely to outmoded eligibility criteria and MSTR’s legacy, relatively insignificant, software business. The inclusion forces purchases by everyone tracking the indexes. As for disclosure, the SEC’s “Management’s Discussion and Analysis” (MD&A) requires thoughtful managerial assessments of firm prospects, including risks and uncertainties as to key business drivers. As drafted, it is unclear if the MD&A reaches the mNAV driver of BTCos like MSTR.

An Afterword briefly notes certain May 5, 2026 MSTR updates.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从法律与经济学角度系统分析MicroStrategy（现MSTR）的“比特币 treasury 公司”（BTCo）模式。该公司的核心运作不依赖生产经营，而是通过溢价发行股票募集资金购买比特币，使新增股东补贴老股东，形成一种"内部套利"。文章提出"企业自我观照"（corporate omphaloskepsis）和"财务风险多药合用"（polypharmacy of financial risk）两个概念，揭示了该模式在目的、手段上与传统上市公司的根本差异，并指出了其在投资者保护和社会福利方面的独特风险。最后，文章基于中立性原则提出针对指数纳入和SEC披露规则的改进建议。
AI.research_question: MSTR/BTCo模式的法律与经济本质是什么？该模式对股东保护和社会福利产生了哪些独特影响？应当如何回应？
AI.motivation: MSTR股价在不到五年内上涨27倍（年化110%），众多企业效仿其BTCo模式，但学术界对此尚无系统研究。该模式与传统公司基于生产经营的运作逻辑截然不同，亟需从法律与经济学角度加以分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 企业自我观照（Corporate Omphaloskepsis）：企业只关注两个内部数字——比特币价格和股价溢价，外部世界仅在其影响这两个数字时才具有意义。2. 财务风险多药合用（Polypharmacy of Financial Risk）：形容投资者面临的多重风险（比特币波动性、MSTR作为比特币巨鲸的地位、放大后的比特币敞口、实质/过程/监管风险）之间存在反射性耦合，整体风险暴露更接近奈特式不确定性而非可计算风险。
AI.method: 法律与经济学分析，概念构建，规范分析
AI.findings: 1. MSTR的核心目的属于极端的"金融化"股东财富最大化，其核心手段（通过股价溢价发行股票购买比特币）与经营型公司完全不同。2. 维持溢价需要完成一系列独特任务：通过资本结构放大比特币敞口、推广比特币、以异常强度迎合投资者异质性。3. 投资者面临多重且相互耦合的风险，接近奈特式不确定性，零售投资者问题尤为突出。4. 社会层面，MSTR倡导将证券发行所得从产品开发转向比特币持有，削弱了创新驱动的经济活力。5. 现有私人秩序（指数纳入标准）和SEC披露规则（MD&A）无意中偏向了BTCo模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次从学术角度系统分析BTCo模式的法律与经济学，填补了理论空白。2. 提出"企业自我观照"概念，精准刻画了MSTR这种以内生价格差而非生产经营为核心驱动力的企业范式。3. 提出"财务风险多药合用"概念，揭示了多重风险之间反射性耦合的独特风险结构，拓展了对奈特式不确定性的理解。4. 将MSTR模式与传统公司法中的股东财富最大化理论进行对比，揭示了"金融化"的极端形态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出了MSCI全球可投资市场指数和纳斯达克-100指数在纳入标准上的过时性，建议调整以区分经营型公司和BTCo模式。2. 指出SEC的MD&A规则在覆盖mNAV这一关键业务驱动因素上的模糊性，建议明确要求BTCo披露溢价驱动因素。3. 基于中立性原则提出改进建议，不预设MSTR或比特币的合法性，具有制度可操作性。

title: Managing Green Technology Spillovers in Competitive Supply Chains
affiliations: Renmin University of China, School of Business, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Managing Green Technology Spillovers in Competitive Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Consumer-facing firms increasingly invest in suppliers' carbon-reduction technologies to lower product carbon footprints. When suppliers serve competing downstream firms, however, such investments may spill over to rivals, creating a supplier decarbonization dilemma: buyer-led investment can reduce emissions but also erode the investor's competitive advantage. We develop a game-theoretical model of two firms in quantity competition in which a focal firm invests in a supplier's carbon-reduction technology and a rival may benefit through shared-supplier spillovers. We show that spillovers reduce the focal firm's investment and profit, and may also increase total emissions. The environmental outcome is governed by three forces: spillovers spread cleaner technology to the rival, weaken the focal firm's investment incentive, and change total production. Although spillovers diffuse cleaner technology, total emissions can rise when reduced investment and output-scale effects dominate the diffusion benefit, especially under intermediate competition. We then compare two spillover-management schemes: carbon offsets and royalty fees. Contrary to common intuition, offsets always increase supplier technology investment by expanding the focal firm's green demand and production scale. Royalty fees increase investment only when the fee is sufficiently low; a high fee can shrink the rival's use of the shared technology, reducing the royalty base and the focal firm's marginal return from investment. Both schemes can achieve an all-win outcome---higher profits for both firms and lower emissions---only when initial emission intensity is low. Offsets additionally require low investment cost and not-too-intense competition, whereas royalty fees require a sufficiently low fee. When initial emission intensity is high, only royalty fees can deliver a second-best outcome, raising total profit and reducing emissions by disciplining output expansion. Our results provide an operational guide for managing green technology spillovers in competitive supply chains.

AI.tldr: 下游企业投资供应商碳减排技术时，技术会 spillover 到竞争对手，形成“供应商脱碳困境”。本文通过博弈模型分析 spillover 对环境的影响，并比较碳抵消与许可费两种管理机制的效果。
AI.research_question: 当供应商服务于多个竞争的下游企业时，下游企业投资供应商碳减排技术所产生的技术溢出效应如何影响投资激励、企业利润与总排放？两种溢出管理机制（碳抵消与许可费）能否实现“共赢”？
AI.motivation: 现实中下游企业（如品牌商）越来越多地投资供应商减排技术，但技术可能 spillover 到竞争对手，削弱投资方的竞争优势。已有文献未充分研究这种溢出在竞争供应链中的环境影响及管理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双寡头古诺数量竞争博弈模型，考虑技术溢出效应（spillover）、碳抵消与许可费两种溢出管理机制。
AI.method: 博弈论模型分析与数值求解。
AI.findings: 1. 技术溢出会降低投资方投资与利润，并可能增加总排放，取决于扩散效益、投资减少效应与产量规模效应三者的平衡。2. 碳抵消总能增加投资（通过扩大绿色需求与产量规模）；许可费仅在费用足够低时增加投资。3. 两种机制都只有在初始排放强度低时才能实现“共赢”（利润更高、排放更低）；初始排放强度高时，只有许可费能实现次优结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了供应商脱碳困境中 spillover 的三种环境效应（扩散、投资抑制、产量变化），并系统比较了碳抵消与许可费两种治理机制的适用条件与效果差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争性供应链中管理绿色技术溢出的企业和管理者提供了具体操作指南，如不同条件下选择碳抵消还是许可费策略。

title: The Hidden Cost Structure of Heavy Road Freight: A Multi-Driver Analysis for Italy (2012–2025)

detail.title: The Hidden Cost Structure of Heavy Road Freight: A Multi-Driver Analysis for Italy (2012–2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. This research relies exclusively on publicly available data (MIT, ISTAT, Eurostat, ECB, ATRI) and received no funding.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs the dynamics of operating costs in the Italian heavy road freight sector between 2012 and 2025 using a moving-weight Törnqvist index, anchored to the cost benchmarks published by the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (MIT). The reconstruction of cost shares in the unobserved quarters adopts a three-level architecture: a structural interpolation between regimes in compositional space, a cyclical correction via Ridge regression, and direct substitution in the quarters for which a benchmark is available. Of the 56 quarters, 12 are observed and 44 reconstructed. The index rises from 100 to about 124 in the fourth quarter of 2025 (95% CI: [123.8, 124.2]). The cumulative decomposition shows that capital (+0.104) and labour (+0.087) are the structural drivers of growth, while fuel is cumulatively negative (-0.023) and acts as an amplifier of short-run volatility. The comparison with the ISTAT producer price index for road freight services (SPPI) documents a substantially complete cumulative pass-through (+24.8% tariffs against +24.0% costs), but with significant time lags during the 2021-2022 energy shock, when the cost-tariff gap reached 7.3%. A financial memory model, built on the observed cost-tariff gap and the cost of borrowing for firms (ECB), produces a wedge that peaks at 0.43 index points (fourth quarter of 2023) with a wedge/CI ratio of 1.15. The wedge is amplified by the mechanism of tax advance payments, which contributes about 23% of the pressure stock at the peak. The results are translated into three-tier tariff benchmarks - operating, prudential, and fiscally consistent - calibrated on a structure of fixed daily costs and variable per-kilometre costs that yields a 2012 base tariff of about 456 euros per day, consistent with sector evidence. The cross-country comparison with the United States market, obtained by applying the same methodology to ATRI (American Transportation Research Institute) data, confirms the generalizability of the structural result: in both markets fuel is cumulatively negative, while labour and capital dominate growth. The divergence between the two indices (+20% Italy against +35% USA over 2012-2024) is almost entirely attributable to driver-wage growth in the North American market.

AI.tldr: 本文利用移动权重Törnqvist指数重建了2012-2025年意大利重型公路货运行业的运营成本动态，发现资本和劳动力是结构性增长驱动因素，而燃料成本累计为负并放大短期波动。成本与关税基本完全传导，但存在显著时滞。研究还开发了财务记忆模型和三层次关税基准，并与美国市场进行了跨国比较。
AI.research_question: 意大利重型公路货运行业运营成本在2012-2025年间的动态变化如何？成本与关税的传导机制是否完整？
AI.motivation: 以往研究缺乏对货运行业成本动态的高频、结构性分解，特别是缺少对未观测季度的成本份额重建方法，以及成本-关税传导时滞和财务压力的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动权重Törnqvist指数、三层次成本重建架构（结构插值、周期性修正、直接替代）、财务记忆模型、成本-关税传导理论
AI.method: 采用移动权重Törnqvist指数，基于意大利基础设施与交通部（MIT）发布的成本基准，通过三层次架构（结构插值、Ridge回归周期性修正、直接替代）重建56个季度中44个未观测季度的成本份额。另使用财务记忆模型分析成本-关税缺口与借贷成本的关系。
AI.findings: （1）成本指数从100上升至2025年Q4约124（95% CI: [123.8, 124.2]）；（2）资本（+0.104）和劳动力（+0.087）是结构性增长驱动，燃料累计为负（-0.023）且放大短期波动；（3）成本-关税累计传导基本完全（+24.8% vs +24.0%），但2021-2022年能源冲击期间缺口达7.3%；（4）财务压力在2023年Q4达峰值0.43，税收预缴贡献约23%；（5）与美国对比发现两国燃料均为负贡献，但美国劳动力（司机工资）增长远超意大利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了未观测季度成本份额的三层次重建方法，发展了成本-关税传导的时滞量化框架，构建了财务记忆模型以量化财务压力，并提供了跨国比较的结构性证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利货运行业提供了三层次关税基准（运营性、审慎性、财政一致性），帮助企业进行定价和风险管理；揭示了税收预缴对财务压力的放大效应，为政策制定提供参考；跨国比较为不同市场的成本结构差异提供了实证依据。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission in India: A VAR vs. VECM Analysis of the Inflation Targeting Regime

detail.title: Monetary Policy Transmission in India: A VAR vs. VECM Analysis of the Inflation Targeting Regime
detail.abstract: This paper examines monetary policy transmission in India over 2001-2024, with focus on the structural break introduced by formal inflation targeting adoption in May 2016. Using VAR on first-differenced data and VECM preserving long-run cointegrating relationships, we document that transmission is undetectable in VAR specifications across both full-sample and post-2016 subsamples, attributable to information loss from differencing a discrete policy rate instrument and full-sample regime heterogeneity, not absence of transmission. Johansen cointegration confirms one long-run equilibrium among the repo rate, inflation, M3, and the exchange rate. The cointegrating vector on inflation reverses sign from +1.29 in the full sample to-16.04 post-2016, providing direct statistical confirmation of the regime shift from reactive to proactive monetary policy. Post-2016 VECM forecast error variance decomposition reveals M3 as the dominant proximate channel, accounting for 55.6% of inflation variance at 12 months and 72.3% at 24 months , entirely invisible to differenced VAR specifications. These findings suggest that model specification choice is the binding constraint in empirical transmission research for emerging economies undergoing institutional regime change.

title: Building Markets without Burning Them: Demand Shaping and Capacity Expansion in Developing Economies
affiliations: and California State Polytechnic University, Pomona - College of Business Administration

detail.title: Building Markets without Burning Them: Demand Shaping and Capacity Expansion in Developing Economies
detail.abstract: Problem Definition: In developing economies, scaling service-intensive technologies creates a critical tension between rapid customer acquisition and thin endogenous capacity. If demand outpaces operational readiness, early adopters experience severe service failures. In thin-information environments, these failures generate negative localized word-of-mouth, permanently destroying future market potential (irreversible market burn). We investigate how platforms should dynamically coordinate demand shaping and capacity expansion to scale safely. Methodology: We formulate an infinite-horizon dynamic control problem utilizing a “fast” demand-shaping instrument and a “slow” capacity-building instrument. Customer adoption follows a Sampling Equilibrium with Statistical Inference (SESI), capturing how boundedly rational users make myopic, one-shot adoption decisions based on localized, platform-shaped signals. Results: We reveal that capacity expansion is a double-edged sword: it relieves operational constraints but endogenously induces demand that, if unconstrained, triggers a strictly convex cascade of market burn. Our Sequencing Theorem proves the optimal rollout is strictly state-dependent. Rather than universally maximizing early adoption, the platform must deliberately cool demand to shield fragile users from service failures, while leveraging robust segments as “capacity incubators.” The policy pivots to aggressive promotion only after accumulated surplus sufficiently expands system-wide readiness. Managerial Implications: Maximizing immediate adoption before capacity matures guarantees systemic overload, while ignoring active demand shaping traps the system in a poverty equilibrium. Coordinated sequencing strictly dominates these benchmarks. Under cross-subgroup information spillovers, platforms must implement a “Firewall Effect,” intensifying early demand cooling to protect fragile users from the visible success of robust peers. Ultimately, successful scaling requires treating early adoption as a calibrated lever to finance infrastructure without causing permanent market damage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了发展中经济体的平台如何通过动态协调需求塑造与产能扩张来实现安全规模化，揭示了"市场烧伤"的不可逆风险，并提出了最优的状态依赖型推广策略。
AI.research_question: 在薄信息环境中，平台应如何动态协调需求塑造（快速工具）与产能扩张（慢速工具），以避免因服务失败导致的不可逆市场烧伤？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体的平台在规模化服务密集型技术时面临关键张力：快速获客与内生产能不足之间的冲突。如果需求超过运营准备，早期用户将遭遇严重服务失败，在薄信息环境下这些失败会产生负面口碑并永久摧毁未来市场潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于采样均衡与统计推断（SESI）的客户采纳模型；无限时域动态控制问题；快（需求塑造）慢（产能建设）双工具协调框架。
AI.method: 构建无限时域动态控制问题，利用需求塑造（快速工具）和产能扩张（慢速工具），客户采纳遵循SESI模型（有限理性、短视、一次性采纳决策）。
AI.findings: (1) 产能扩张是双刃剑：缓解运营约束但内生诱导需求，若不加约束将触发严格凸性的市场烧伤级联；(2) 排序定理证明最优推广策略是严格状态依赖的；(3) 平台必须主动冷却需求以保护脆弱用户，同时利用稳健细分市场作为"产能孵化器"；(4) 跨子群体信息溢出时需实施"防火墙效应"以隔离早期成功对脆弱用户的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了排序定理（Sequencing Theorem），证明了最优推广是严格状态依赖的；揭示了产能扩张的双刃剑效应及其引发的市场烧伤凸性级联；提出了"防火墙效应"概念，阐明了跨子群体信息溢出下的需求冷却机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中经济体平台提供可操作的规模化策略：早期应主动冷却需求而非最大化采纳，利用稳健用户作为产能孵化器，在累积剩余足够后才转向激进推广，并针对信息溢出实施防火墙策略。

title: Managing Green Technology Spillovers in Competitive Supply Chains
affiliations: Renmin University of China, School of Business, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Managing Green Technology Spillovers in Competitive Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Consumer-facing firms increasingly invest in suppliers' carbon-reduction technologies to lower product carbon footprints. AI.tldr: 本文研究了下游买家投资上游供应商碳减排技术时，技术外溢对竞争对手的影响，并比较了碳抵消与许可费两种溢出管理方案的效果。
AI.research_question: 当供应商服务多个竞争性下游企业时，买方的碳减排技术投资如何受溢出效应影响？哪种溢出管理方案（碳抵消 vs. 许可费）能实现经济与环境双赢？
AI.motivation: 现实中有大量下游企业投资供应商清洁技术（如沃尔玛的供应链减排项目），但技术溢出到竞争对手可能削弱投资动机，甚至导致总排放上升。现有文献对此困境缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，基于古诺数量竞争框架，考虑共享供应商技术溢出、投资激励、产量调节等机制。
AI.method: 构建两阶段博弈模型：第一阶段买方决定投资水平，第二阶段两下游企业进行数量竞争。分别分析无方案、碳抵消方案、许可费方案三种情景。
AI.findings: (1) 溢出降低焦点企业投资和利润，且可能增加总排放；(2) 碳抵消总能增加投资，许可费仅在费率足够低时有效；(3) 仅当初始排放强度低时，两种方案才可能实现"三赢"；(4) 初始排放强度高时，许可费可产生次优结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"供应商脱碳困境"的三种作用力（技术扩散、投资弱化、产量变化），并系统比较了两种溢出管理机制的条件与效果，丰富了绿色供应链和可持续运营管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为买方企业在竞争性供应链中管理绿色技术溢出提供了决策指南，包括何时采用碳抵消、何时采用许可费，以及如何设定费率等可操作建议。

title: Pricing Carbon or Salience? Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets
affiliations: Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: Pricing Carbon or Salience? Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: Doctoral Work, LSU

detail.abstract: In equity markets, investor preferences are confounded with carbon transition risk because carbon intensity proxies for future regulatory liability. I address this identification problem by exploiting cryptocurrency markets, where carbon regulations do not exist during the period of my study. I show that preferences operate through attention shocks that make environmental concerns salient rather than through continuous carbon pricing. Attention events impact trading behavior and returns, while changes in carbon intensity don’t. My findings resolve a central debate on investor preferences in ESG literature.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加密货币市场（研究期间不存在碳监管）来解决权益市场中投资者偏好与碳转型风险混淆的识别问题。研究发现投资者偏好通过引起环境关注的注意力冲击起作用，而非持续碳定价，注意力事件影响交易行为和回报，而碳强度变化则无此效应。
AI.research_question: 在权益市场中，投资者偏好与碳转型风险因碳强度作为未来监管责任的代理变量而相互混淆，如何解决这一识别问题？
AI.motivation: ESG文献中关于投资者偏好的核心争论始终未能解决，因为权益市场中碳强度同时反映了投资者偏好和未来的监管风险，两者无法区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者偏好通过注意力冲击（attention shocks）而非持续碳定价发挥作用的理论视角。
AI.method: 利用加密货币市场（研究期间不存在碳监管）作为自然实验环境，解决识别问题。
AI.findings: （1）注意力事件（attention events）影响交易行为和回报；（2）碳强度变化不影响交易行为和回报；（3）投资者偏好通过使环境问题变得显著的注意力冲击起作用，而非通过连续的碳定价机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了ESG文献中关于投资者偏好如何影响市场行为与回报的核心争论，明确了注意力冲击而非碳定价是投资者偏好发挥作用的关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解ESG投资中投资者行为的驱动因素提供了新的视角，启示政策制定者和市场参与者关注环境议题的显著性而非仅仅碳强度指标。

title: Toward a Practitioner Epistemology: A Methodological Position for Curated Depth in Fractional Professional Practice

detail.title: Toward a Practitioner Epistemology: A Methodological Position for Curated Depth in Fractional Professional Practice
detail.abstract:
Fractional practitioners are hired for what they know. They are retained and renewed for the value they deliver. A fractional CISO enters an organization to address a cybersecurity crisis; what earns renewal is the discovery that the same decisions keep stalling at the leadership level, week after week, for reasons no one in the room can name. A fractional CFO is brought in to restructure the books; what makes the engagement indispensable is the recognition that no one in the organization has the authority or the trust to surface financial reality. The subject matter expertise is the entry ticket. The interpretive work---reading the organizational system, surfacing the evergreen patterns of avoidance and defense that produced the crisis or exposed the gap---is where the practitioner's outsized value lives. And the practitioner who can do this work systematically---who accumulates a documented corpus of observations, patterns, and outcomes within each engagement---builds something more than a reputation. They build a track record that validates the cycle: client reviews that document value the organization could not have surfaced on its own, referrals that carry the practitioner's reputation into new engagements, and renewal rates that prove the work was not finished when the crisis was resolved or the gap filled. That track record---reviews, referrals, renewals---is the practitioner's evidence that structured interpretive work produces results, and it justifies a consultative premium that volume-based practice never can. The practitioner without this methodology starts from scratch every session---same expertise, no accumulation, no documented pattern recognition, no compounding proof of what the interpretive work produces. Yet no tool available to the fractional practitioner provides a methodological framework for this interpretive work. There is no preserved context within engagements, no longitudinal accumulation across observations, no structured method for surfacing what organizations cannot see about themselves, and---most consequentially---no instrument for reading the dynamics of leadership systems under change pressure, where the deliverable depends as much on what the practitioner sees forming as on what is technically delivered.

This paper presents a methodological position for a new class of augmented professional practice. With 5.6 million high-earning independent professionals in the United States alone, the fractional executive represents a permanent and growing professional class---yet the interpretive work that drives their value has no methodological foundation. It argues that such a foundation must be built on three principles: first, that organizational complexity is irreducibly human---people and process intertwined---and that any methodology that treats organizations as purely technical systems will miss the dynamics that matter most; second, that the patterns practitioners need to surface are resistant to conventional methods of discovery---surveys, structured interviews, assessment frameworks---because they operate below the level of what organizations can see about themselves, which is why they persist even when everyone agrees something needs to change; and third, that artificial intelligence can and must compound the practitioner's own analytical judgment rather than replace it, operating within a curated framework rather than on undifferentiated general knowledge.

The Undercurrent platform is the implementation of that argument. This paper grounds these principles in specific research traditions, names the theoretical foundations that explain why organizational patterns resist examination, draws the central distinction between curated analytical depth and context-free alternatives, and proposes a blinded comparative evaluation protocol to test the framework's claims.

AI.tldr: 本文为一种新型增强型专业实践——零散高管（fractional executive）提出方法论基础。文章指出，零散高管的主题专业知识只是入场券，真正的价值在于"诠释性工作"——解读组织系统、揭示产生危机的回避与防御模式。文章提出三个核心原则：组织复杂性不可还原地关乎人性；需要发现的模式抵抗传统调查方法；人工智能应增强而非替代从业者的分析判断。Undercurrent平台是这一方法论的实施。
AI.research_question: 零散高管（如零散CISO、零散CFO）的"诠释性工作"应如何被方法论化、系统化地支持？人工智能如何在这一过程中增强而非替代从业者的判断力？
AI.motivation: 美国有560万高收入独立专业人士，零散高管是永久且不断增长的专业阶层，但推动其价值的"诠释性工作"缺乏方法论基础。现有工具无法为这一工作提供方法框架——没有跨参与的语境保存、没有纵向的模式积累、没有结构化方法来揭示组织对自身不可见的东西。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三个核心原则：1）组织复杂性不可还原地具有人性（人与流程交织），纯技术视角会遗漏最重要的动态；2）从业者需要揭示的模式抵抗调查、结构化访谈等传统方法，因为它们运作在组织对自身可见水平之下；3）人工智能应在一个精心策划的框架内增强从业者的分析判断，而非替代它。
AI.method: 本文阐述方法论立场，提出三个原则；介绍Undercurrent平台作为该论点的实施；提出一个盲法比较评估协议来测试该框架的有效性。
AI.findings: 零散高管的主题专业知识是入场券，但真正的巨大价值在于诠释性工作；能够系统性进行诠释性工作的从业者会建立验证性轨迹（客户评价、推荐、续约），证明结构化诠释工作产生成果，并证明基于咨询的溢价合理。
AI.theory_contributions: 为零散高管这一新兴且不断增长的专业阶层提出首个系统化的方法论基础；区分了"主题专业知识"与"诠释性工作"的价值层级；论证了为什么组织模式抵抗传统发现方法，以及AI应如何以增强而非替代的方式介入。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零散高管提供了一套可操作的方法论框架（通过Undercurrent平台实施），使其能够在每次参与中保存语境、纵向积累观察、结构化地揭示组织对自身不可见的模式，从而建立可验证的轨迹（评价、推荐、续约），将客户价值转化为可量化的咨询溢价。

title: Load Balancing for Large Language Model Inference Serving: A Control and Learning Oriented Survey
affiliations: The University of Manchester - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Southeast  University, Nanjing, The University of Manchester - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, The University of Manchester - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, The University of Manchester - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Loughborough University and The University of Manchester - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

detail.title: Load Balancing for Large Language Model Inference Serving: A Control and Learning Oriented Survey
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed as interactive neural inference services, where performance depends on how compute, memory, communication bandwidth, and persistent state are allocated under non-stationary demand. This survey studies load balancing for LLM inference serving as an intelligent scheduling and resource-allocation problem for large-scale learning systems. The analysis focuses on imbalance induced by prefill–decode phase asymmetry, key–value (KV) cache residency, heavy-tailed request variability, heterogeneous hardware, and service-level objectives (SLOs). A structured review protocol codes representative studies by imbalance source, observable signals, control knobs, assumptions, limitations, and evaluation evidence. We introduce a state– action–constraint abstraction, compare six strategy families, and synthesize evaluation practice around tail latency, time to first token (TTFT), token cadence, goodput, robustness, and energy per SLO-compliant token. Open directions are discussed for long-context and multimodal serving, decentralized deployment, green inference, and autonomous self-adaptive serving.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了大语言模型推理服务中的负载均衡问题，分析了由prefill-decode阶段不对称、KV缓存驻留、重尾请求变异、异构硬件和SLO等因素引起的负载失衡，提出了状态-动作-约束抽象框架，比较了六种策略家族，并讨论了长上下文、多模态服务、去中心化部署等未来方向。
AI.research_question: 在大语言模型推理服务中，如何在非平稳需求下通过智能调度和资源分配实现有效的负载均衡？
AI.motivation: LLM推理服务面临独特的负载失衡挑战（如prefill-decode不对称、KV缓存占用等），传统负载均衡方法难以直接适用，需要系统性的综述来梳理问题、方法和评估实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态-动作-约束（State-Action-Constraint）抽象框架、六种策略家族分类法
AI.method: 结构化综述协议，按失衡来源、可观测信号、控制旋钮、假设条件、局限性和评估证据对代表性研究进行编码分类。
AI.findings: LLM推理负载失衡主要来自五个维度：prefill-decode阶段不对称、KV缓存驻留时间差异、重尾请求分布、异构硬件和SLO约束；六种策略家族各有适用场景；评估实践聚焦于尾延迟、TTFT、token节奏、goodput、鲁棒性和每SLO合规token的能耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的状态-动作-约束抽象框架，将分散的负载均衡方法纳入系统性的策略分类体系，为后续研究提供了理论分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM推理服务部署提供了负载均衡策略的选择指南；指出了长上下文、多模态、去中心化部署和绿色推理等实践方向。

title: Development and Industrial Validation of an Automated Aerodynamic Cleaner for Heavy-Impurity Separation in Cotton Pneumatic Conveying Systems
affiliations: Karshi State Technical university, Namangan State Technical University, Namangan State Technical University, Namangan State Technical University, Research Institute of Fiber Crops, Lukoil Uzbekistan Operating Company LLC, Jizzakh Polytechnical Institute, Urgench State University, Fergana State Technical University and Termez State University

detail.title: Development and Industrial Validation of an Automated Aerodynamic Cleaner for Heavy-Impurity Separation in Cotton Pneumatic Conveying Systems
detail.abstract:
Heavy impurities such as stones, metallic fragments, and compacted mineral clods entrained in pneumatic cotton-conveying systems can damage gin saws, increase fire hazards, disrupt processing stability, and reduce fiber quality. Conventional stone catchers often rely on manual impurity discharge, resulting in airflow disturbances, re-entrainment of impurities, and increased operational downtime. This study presents the development and industrial validation of an automated aerodynamic cleaner designed for continuous heavy-impurity removal from seed cotton without interrupting pneumatic conveying conditions.
The developed cleaner integrates three functional components within a single working chamber: an adjustable inclined grate-guide for cotton fluffing and impurity release, a front-wall grate preventing cotton loss into the collector, and a rotating drum-shaped valve enabling automated impurity discharge while maintaining negative-pressure stability. Airflow behaviour and particle trajectories were analysed using numerical modelling and SolidWorks CFD simulations. A 2³ full-factorial experimental design was applied to optimize the principal geometric parameters of the cleaner. The optimal configuration was identified as a grate inclination angle of 30°, spike spacing of 30 mm, and guide distance of 140 mm, with regression models demonstrating high predictive capability (R² > 0.96).
Laboratory investigations showed a mean heavy-impurity separation efficiency of 87%, compared with 79% for the conventional 2CHTL stone catcher. Separation efficiency for coarse impurities exceeded 98%, reaching 98–100% for particles larger than 35 mm. HVI 900-SA fiber testing confirmed that the cleaning process improved fiber strength from 42.5 to 43.1 gs tex⁻¹ and elongation from 7.0% to 7.5%, while preserving micronaire, fiber length, uniformity, and color characteristics.
Full-scale industrial trials conducted in a commercial cotton gin demonstrated 98% impurity separation efficiency, a 62.5% reduction in installed power demand, improved fiber classification grade, stable continuous operation, and elimination of fire incidents associated with heavy-impurity ingress. The developed cleaner provides a practical engineering solution for automated impurity removal in cotton pneumatic conveying systems while simultaneously improving process reliability, energy efficiency, operational safety, and fiber quality

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种用于棉花气力输送系统的自动化气动清杂机，能够在不中断输送条件下连续去除重杂质（石块、金属等），实验室分离效率达87%，工业试验达98%，同时降低了能耗、提升了纤维品质并消除了火灾隐患。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够在棉花气力输送系统不停机条件下自动连续去除重杂质的工程装置？
AI.motivation: 传统石块捕捉器依赖人工排杂，导致气流扰动、杂质二次夹带和停机时间增加，且重杂质会损坏轧花锯片、增加火灾风险、破坏加工稳定性并降低纤维品质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气固两相流理论、CFD数值模拟（SolidWorks）、2³全因子实验设计与回归分析。
AI.method: 集成式结构设计（可调倾斜格栅导板+前壁格栅+旋转鼓式阀门）；SolidWorks CFD数值模拟分析气流行为与颗粒轨迹；2³全因子实验设计优化几何参数；实验室测试与全规模工业验证。
AI.findings: 最优参数：格栅倾角30°、钉齿间距30mm、导板距离140mm（R²>0.96）；实验室重杂质分离效率87%（传统79%），粗杂质>98%，>35mm颗粒达98-100%；工业试验分离效率98%，装机功率降低62.5%，纤维强度从42.5提升至43.1 gs/tex，延伸率从7.0%提升至7.5%，火灾事故消除。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气动清杂机几何参数（倾角、钉距、导距）与分离效率之间的定量关系，建立了高预测精度的回归模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需中断输送、自动连续排杂的工程解决方案，显著降低能耗（62.5%）、提升纤维品质、消除火灾隐患，并已在商业轧花厂通过工业验证。

title: Can Daoism Drive Innovation? Quanzhen, Zhengyi, and Corporate Innovation in Contemporary China
affiliations: and University Putra Malaysia - Institute for Mathematical Research

detail.title: Can Daoism Drive Innovation? Quanzhen, Zhengyi, and Corporate Innovation in Contemporary China
detail.abstract: This study examines whether sectarian differences within Daoism (between the Quanzhen and Zhengyi traditions) have left a measurable imprint on corporate innovation in contemporary China. Using geo-coded data on registered Daoist temples and firm-level research and development (R&D) data on Chinese listed companies, we find that stronger local Quanzhen presence, relative to Zhengyi, is associated with substantially higher corporate R&D investment. After addressing endogeneity, the association holds. It is not statistically significant in coastal regions; it is most pronounced among private firms in inland provinces, where cultural norms have the greatest latitude to shape managerial decisions. The findings are consistent with Daoist cultural traditions contributing to indigenous corporate innovation in China, with associations that depend on which Daoist tradition is present and where formal institutions leave room for cultural norms to operate.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，道教内部派系差异（全真派 vs 正一派）对中国当代企业创新有显著影响：全真派寺庙密度高的地区，企业研发投入更高，这一效应在内陆省份的民营企业中尤为突出。
AI.research_question: 道教内部的派系差异（全真派与正一派）是否以及如何影响中国当代企业的创新行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注儒家文化对经济发展的影响，但道教作为中国本土宗教，其内部派系差异对企业创新的影响尚未被系统检验。理解这一关系有助于揭示文化传统在正式制度薄弱地区的替代性作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化经济学理论、宗教社会学理论、制度经济学理论（正式制度与文化规范的替代关系）
AI.method: 基于地理编码的道教寺庙注册数据与中国上市公司研发数据，构建区域层面道教派系密度指标，采用回归分析及内生性处理方法进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）全真派相对正一派的当地影响力越大，企业研发投入越高；（2）该效应在沿海地区不显著；（3）在内陆省份的民营企业中最为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宗教内部派系差异纳入文化经济学分析框架，揭示了道教传统对中国本土企业创新的异质性影响，丰富了制度与文化互动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国区域创新差异提供了文化维度解释，提示企业在不同制度环境下应关注本土文化传统的实际影响力；为政策制定者考虑地区文化禀赋与创新政策匹配提供参考。

title: Substitutes or Complements? How Employee Helping Behavior is Influenced by Observability and Discretionary Compensation
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Accounting and Villanova University - Accountancy

detail.title: Substitutes or Complements? How Employee Helping Behavior is Influenced by Observability and Discretionary Compensation
detail.abstract: Evidence suggests that organizational performance is improved when employees provide greater effort toward helping teammates. However, helping behavior is not frequently contracted upon in practice, and relatively little is known about how common elements of the control environment fundamentally influence employees’ inclinations to help others. In an experiment, we predict and find that as compared to a baseline condition where helping is not observable by the team manager and the manager has no control over employees’ compensation, employees choose greater helping behavior when either helping is observable by the manager or when the manager controls a discretionary bonus pool. We further find that the two factors interact with each other in a way that is partly substitutive, and that the separate effect of observability is greater than the separate effect of discretionary compensation. Additional results suggest that employees devote less costly (productive) effort toward helping at a greater rate than more costly (productive) effort, suggesting that the opportunity cost of effort may further play a role in helping decisions. Our study contributes to research and practice by highlighting to managers how elements of the performance information environment and common incentive contracts generate potential benefits for helping behavior that can improve individual and group outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，当管理者能够观察到员工的帮助行为，或管理者拥有可自由支配的奖金池时，员工会更倾向于帮助同事。这两种因素部分替代，且可观察性的单独效应大于自由裁量薪酬的单独效应。
AI.research_question: 控制环境中哪些常见因素会影响员工帮助同事的行为倾向？
AI.motivation: 帮助行为能提升组织绩效，但实践中很少被正式契约化，学界对控制环境如何影响帮助行为的了解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 帮助行为的可观察性理论、自由裁量薪酬激励理论、努力的机会成本理论。
AI.method: 实验研究（实验法）
AI.findings: 可观察性和自由裁量薪酬均能提升帮助行为；两者部分替代；可观察性的单独效应大于自由裁量薪酬；员工倾向于付出低成本帮助而非高成本帮助。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示可观察性与自由裁量薪酬对帮助行为的交互作用（部分替代性），以及机会成本在帮助决策中的角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 向管理者指出：绩效信息环境和激励契约设计能够促进员工帮助行为，从而改善个人和团队绩效。

title: CDN/TLS Termination Path Dependency as a Quantum-Vulnerable Architecture: An Outside-In Diagnosis for Regulated Banking

detail.title: CDN/TLS Termination Path Dependency as a Quantum-Vulnerable Architecture: An Outside-In Diagnosis for Regulated Banking

declarations.ethicsApproval: The author attests that the nature of this research has not, to date, required any collection of personal or private institutional data, but has nevertheless been conducted in accordance with appropriate ethical standards for research based on published sources.
declarations.funderStatement: The author did not receive any funding for this research from any source.

detail.abstract: Regulated banks increasingly terminate customer-facing transport-layer encryption not at their own infrastructure but at a third-party content delivery network (CDN) edge, where the protecting cipher is undone, customer content is processed as cleartext and the CDN applies its own fresh onward encryption. Such an arrangement leaves the bank carrying non-delegable regulatory responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity of data whose cryptography it no longer controls, can no longer observe and can no longer unilaterally change. This note argues that the arrangement is a present-tense surrender of cryptographic control and, read against the transition to post-quantum cryptography, a quantum-vulnerable path dependency that the regulated entity cannot remediate on its own terms. The argument does not depend on the timing of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. The security literature has established that interposed TLS termination weakens connection security, but has approached the edge from two directions that miss this reading: measurement studies framed interception as something done to an organisation's own outbound traffic, using the CDN as their observation point rather than their subject; by contrast, cryptographic-protocol analyses of inbound edge termination asked only whether the cryptography was sound. Neither asked what it means to hold organisational responsibility for a cryptographic termination junction one does not control. Drawing on the scholarship on jurisdiction over data, the note shows that at the cleartext edge the authority able to compel production follows control of the terminating entity rather than the residency of the data. Thus a bank may be required to answer to its own supervisor for traffic exposed under a foreign legal order. This note locates the resulting mismatch between responsibility and control as a structural barrier to post-quantum migration, distinct from and prior to the economic barriers recent literature has catalogued, since an organisation cannot migrate, audit or reliably inventory cryptography it does not hold; and it observes that hybrid post-quantum key agreement now deployed at the edge, real as it is, protects the journey to the termination point without returning control of it. The note proposes an outside-in orientation for cryptographic readiness that takes the locus of cryptographic control, not the cryptographic asset per se, as its analytic primitive, so surfacing the structural mismatch which an inventory-first PQC migration orientation assumes away. The analysis is confined to banking regulated within the European Union, rests on public documentation and is diagnostic: architectural responses, repatriation of termination included, are treated as a decision space rather than recommended. It is offered as a programme note, framing the problem and the research agenda (in monitoring, legal duty, formal attack-surface modelling and supplier disclosure) that this problem framing logically requires.

AI.tldr: 受监管银行将TLS终止外包给第三方CDN，导致密码控制权丧失、监管责任与权力不匹配，并形成面向量子时代的结构性迁移障碍。
AI.research_question: 当受监管银行将传输层加密终止点外包给第三方CDN时，组织的密码控制权、监管责任与后量子密码迁移之间存在怎样的结构性矛盾？
AI.motivation: 现有安全文献从测量研究和密码协议分析两个方向研究CDN边缘TLS终止，但都未从组织责任与控制权关系的角度审视这一安排。银行对数据机密性和完整性负有不可委托的监管责任，却将密码控制权交给第三方，这一矛盾尚未被充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据管辖权理论（jurisdiction over data）——阐明明文边缘处，能够强制要求交出数据的权威取决于对终止实体的控制，而非数据所在地。
AI.method: 规范性论证，基于欧盟银行监管的公开文档进行诊断性分析
AI.findings: 1) CDN边缘的TLS终止是密码控制权的"现时让渡"，并非技术细节问题而是组织治理问题；2) 这种安排在密码控制权与监管责任之间造成错配，构成了后量子密码迁移的结构性障碍，先于并独立于经济障碍；3) 即使采用混合后量子密钥协商协议，也只保护到终止点，并未归还控制权；4) 应当采用"由外而内"的密码就绪取向，以密码控制权所在位置（而非密码资产本身）作为分析基元。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据管辖权理论引入密码基础设施治理分析，提出"控制权-责任错配"作为理解后量子迁移障碍的新分析框架，指出"先清点资产再迁移"的传统PQC迁移路径实际上假设了这一结构性错配不存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟受监管银行提供密码就绪的诊断框架，提出需要关注的问题议程：监测、法律义务、形式化攻击面建模和供应商披露；将架构性回应（包括终止点回收）定位为决策空间而非重新建议。

title: Beyond Public and Private Service Commoning Service and the Reproductive Meaning of Work

detail.title: Beyond Public and Private Service Commoning Service and the Reproductive Meaning of Work

declarations.ethicsApproval: I have used artificial intelligence to find sources, parse the text, and finalize it.

detail.abstract:
Modern societies are commonly described as service societies, yet the concept of service remains theoretically unsettled. In markets, service is usually understood as a transaction between provider and customer; in public administration, as a provision, entitlement, or performance; and in platform capitalism, as a data-mediated and often invisible relation distributed across global infrastructures. These frameworks obscure the reproductive meaning of service work: the maintenance, repair, and development of the conditions under which human beings, communities, institutions, and ecosystems continue to live. 

This article develops a conceptual reinterpretation of service work through the category of the common. It reconstructs a brief conceptual history of service, from servitium and duty to utility, the service sector, the service economy, and platform service. It then revisits the legal-historical distinction between private, public, and common things, arguing that the public/private binary is insufficient for understanding the life-conditions sustained by service work. The article further argues that commoning service requires a transformation in the concept of property: from dominium, ownership as command, exclusion, and disposal, toward custodium, stewardship as responsibility for the conditions of life. Finally, it proposes the concepts of reproductive service and commoning service as ways to understand service work as civic participation in the responsible reproduction of shared life. 

The argument concludes that the service society should be reinterpreted as a reproductive society. Under ecological realism, all work-including primary production, industrial labour, technological development, care, education, administration, maintenance, repair, and cultural work-must be judged by the life-conditions it serves. Service work is therefore not a residual category of post-industrial capitalism, but one of the institutional cores of ecological civilization. To clarify how work becomes formative rather than merely necessary, the article finally draws on the Finnish concept of sivistys and reinterprets the classical fields of scholē, polis, oikos, and agora as four questions that must be returned to all work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"共同物"范畴重构服务工作的概念，认为服务工作本质上是维系生命条件的再生产劳动，并主张将服务社会重新解释为再生产社会，提出从"支配权"转向"保管权"的财产观念变革。
AI.research_question: 如何通过"共同物"范畴重新理解服务工作的再生产意义？服务社会应被重新解释为什么样的社会形态？
AI.motivation: 现代社会中"服务"概念在理论上尚未得到充分澄清，主流框架（市场交易、公共供给、平台中介）遮蔽了服务工作的再生产意涵——即维护、修复和发展人类、社区、制度及生态系统得以持续生存的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同物理论（common）、公/私/共同物的法律史区分、财产概念的转变（从dominium到custodium）、芬兰sivistys概念、古典领域（scholē, polis, oikos, agora）的 reinterpretation。
AI.method: 概念史梳理（从servitium到平台服务的谱系重构）+ 法律哲学分析 + 理论建构与概念再诠释
AI.findings: 1) 服务工作本质上是维系共同生命条件的再生产劳动；2) 公共/私有的二元框架不足以理解服务工作所维持的生命条件；3) 应将财产从支配权（dominium）转向保管权（custodium）；4) 服务社会应被重新解释为再生产社会；5) 服务工作不是后工业资本主义的残余范畴，而是生态文明的制度核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 通过"共同物"范畴为服务工作提供了全新的理论解释，超越了市场交易、公共供给和平台中介三种主流框架；2) 将财产概念从支配/排他转向保管/责任，为理解服务的公共性提供了新路径；3) 提出"再生产社会"概念，将服务工作提升为生态文明的制度核心。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为重新评估各类工作的社会价值提供了标准——应以其所服务的生命条件为判断依据；2) 借助sivistys概念和古典领域框架，为理解工作如何从"必要劳动"转变为"塑造成长"的实践活动提供了可操作的分析维度。

title: International Business and SDG8: Are We on Course?

detail.title: International Business and SDG8: Are We on Course?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no financial relationships involved
declarations.ethicsApproval: no ethical issues
declarations.funderStatement: no external funding

detail.abstract: The world is facing a 'perfect storm'-a combination of largely man-made crises that puts the governance of the global economic, political, social and health system as developed since the 1990s under increasing pressure. The perfect storm presents a number of fundamental questions for engaged International Business (IB) scholarship. How to assess the action of (multinational) corporations under these circumstances? How to measure the effectiveness of corporate strategies for sustainable development? Moreover, what could engaged IB scholarship focus on in their research and teaching? Why is SDG 8 (decent work and economic growth) thereby particularly relevant? Are we on course?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球面临的"完美风暴"（多重人为危机叠加）对国际商务研究的挑战，重点分析了可持续发展目标8（体面工作和经济增长）的相关性，并提出参与式国际商务研究应关注的问题：跨国公司行为评估、可持续发展战略有效性衡量，以及研究与教学的重点方向。
AI.research_question: 在"完美风暴"背景下，参与式国际商务学术研究应如何评估跨国公司行为、衡量可持续发展战略有效性，以及为何SDG 8（体面工作和经济增长）在此情境下尤为关键？
AI.motivation: 全球正面临多重人为危机（经济、政治、社会、健康等）叠加的"完美风暴"，给1990年代以来建立的全球治理体系带来巨大压力，亟需重新审视国际商务研究的角色与责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展目标框架（特别是SDG 8）、全球治理理论、参与式国际商务学术（engaged IB scholarship）
AI.method: 概念性/评论性论文，通过对当前全球危机的综合分析，提出研究议程和问题框架。
AI.findings: SDG 8（体面工作和经济增长）在"完美风暴"背景下具有特殊相关性，国际商务学者需要采取更积极的参与式研究态度，重新评估跨国公司的作用和可持续发展战略的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"完美风暴"概念引入国际商务研究，为参与式IB学术提供了新的问题框架，强调SDG 8在多重危机中的枢纽作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际商务学者指出了研究与教学的重点方向，提出了评估企业行动和可持续发展战略的具体问题，有助于指导跨国公司在危机环境中的实践。

title: Selecting seasonal filters in X–13–ARIMA via cross-validation
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Selecting seasonal filters in X–13–ARIMA via cross-validation

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Official statistics routinely employs the X–13–ARIMA method to seasonally adjust economic time series. A key step is choosing the length of the seasonal moving average. Traditionally, this choice relies on ad hoc criteria and expert judgement. We propose a cross-validation-based filter selection scheme that offers greater flexibility, including the possibility of incorporating novel filters. This approach is particularly promising for the seasonal adjustment of weekly, daily, and high-frequency time series. We demonstrate how to integrate cross-validation into the X–13–ARIMA method and discuss the advantages of various implementation options. Evaluation on monthly and quarterly time series demonstrates that this selection method performs at least as well as, and often better than, conventional selection criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于交叉验证的滤波器选择方案，用于替代X-13-ARIMA方法中传统的季节性移动平均长度选择标准，在月度、季度数据上表现相当或更优，尤其适用于高频数据。
AI.research_question: 如何为X-13-ARIMA季节性调整方法选择和优化季节性移动平均滤波器的长度？
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖临时标准和专家判断来选择季节性移动平均的长度，缺乏灵活性和客观性，难以适应高频数据的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: X-13-ARIMA季节性调整方法；交叉验证（cross-validation）模型选择理论；时间序列滤波理论。
AI.method: 提出基于交叉验证的滤波器选择方案，将其整合到X-13-ARIMA方法中，并讨论多种实施选项的优缺点；在月度、季度时间序列上进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 交叉验证选择方法在月度、季度时间序列上的表现至少与常规选择标准相当，且在许多情况下更优；该方法特别适用于周度、日度和高频时间序列的季节性调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 将交叉验证框架引入季节性调整的滤波器选择中，增强了选择过程的灵活性和客观性；为高频时间序列的季节性调整提供了一种新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为官方统计机构和实践者提供了一种可操作的、优于传统专家判断的滤波器自动选择方法；有助于改进周度、日度及高频经济时间序列的季节性调整质量。

title: Examining the Role of Public-Private Partnerships in Enhancing Port Infrastructure Efficiency and Global Trade Connectivity
affiliations: Infervision - Institute of Advanced Research and Institute of Advanced Research

detail.title: Examining the Role of Public-Private Partnerships in Enhancing Port Infrastructure Efficiency and Global Trade Connectivity
detail.abstract: Ports have become more reliant on public-private partnerships (PPPs) in solving funding, efficiency and connectivity issues. Still, the effect of PPPs on the global port infrastructure efficiency and trade connectivity is yet to be fully matured. This study examines the role of PPP projects in the development, improvement and use of port infrastructure for the purposes of international trade. In line with the objective of this research work, we also focus to examines PPP initiatives in India, focusing on stakeholders' perspectives, participation, challenges, and recommendations for sustainable PPP model. The primary objective is to analyse the current PPP conditions, challenges, and the prospects for technology application in the sustainability port operations in Indian. Considering the objective of this research, a qualitative case study approach has been taken to execute this study. This research includes analysis of case studies as well as examines critical success factors, challenges, and policy implications focusing on different regions aiming at determining best practices for proper implementation of PPPs in India. The key findings reveal that PPP initiative in port operations has become a tool of enhancing the technology adoption and infrastructure development that enables the global trade connectivity. The PPP initiative enables us to overcome the barriers such as budgetary restrictions, legal weaknesses, and stakeholder reluctance to share the resources. The PPP Model enables stakeholders to prioritise investments in advanced technologies and infrastructure and enhance stakeholder engagement through regular communication and collaborative efforts. However, case analysis also reveal that more work should done in relation to regulatory issues and risk issues. The paper puts forth strategies for policymakers and the stakeholders to enhance the performance of PPP models in relevance to international trade and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性案例研究方法，分析了公私合作制（PPP）在印度港口基础设施发展中的作用，发现PPP模式能够促进技术采用和基础设施建设，从而增强全球贸易连通性，但在监管和风险问题方面仍需进一步改进。
AI.research_question: PPP项目如何在港口基础设施发展、改进和使用中发挥作用，以促进国际贸易？特别是印度PPP项目的现状、挑战及可持续性前景如何？
AI.motivation: 港口越来越依赖PPP来解决资金、效率和连通性问题，但PPP对全球港口基础设施效率和贸易连通性的影响尚未完全成熟，需要进一步研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公私合作制（PPP）理论、利益相关者理论、可持续发展理论。
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，包括案例分析以及对关键成功因素、挑战和政策影响的考察。
AI.findings: 1. PPP倡议已成为促进技术采用和基础设施发展的工具，有助于全球贸易连通；2. PPP能够克服预算限制、法律薄弱环节和利益相关者不愿共享资源等障碍；3. PPP模式使利益相关者能够优先投资先进技术和基础设施，并通过定期沟通和协作增强利益相关者参与；4. 但在监管问题和风险问题方面仍需进一步改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对PPP在港口基础设施领域作用机制的理解，特别是在发展中国家（印度）情境下，丰富了PPP理论与国际贸易连通性之间的关联研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了提升PPP模式绩效的策略建议，特别是在促进国际贸易和可持续发展方面，并指出了需要改进的监管和风险管理方向。

title: The Reach of the World Cup Distraction Effect: Evidence from Global Trading Venues
affiliations: UNIP - Universidade Paulista

detail.title: The Reach of the World Cup Distraction Effect: Evidence from Global Trading Venues

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals. It uses only aggregated, publicly observable or vendor-provided financial market data and contains no personal or identifiable information. Ethics approval was therefore not required
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. Intraday market data were provided by Algoseek. Algoseek had no role in the study design; in the collection, analysis, or interpretation of data; in the writing of the report; or in the decision to submit the article for publication.

detail.abstract: The FIFA World Cup is a clean, globally synchronized attention shock. Yet the markets that now carry most of the world's trading do not visibly respond to it in aggregate, and the headline evidence that they do turns out to be an artifact of how the effect is measured. Ehrmann and Jansen show that trades on a country's national exchange roughly halve when its team plays, carried by a local trader who is also the viewer. Two questions sit conflated on that mechanism: whether the global attention shock moves aggregate trading in the continuous, global, derivative venues where no team maps to the marginal trader, and whether the local effect generalizes beyond its first exchange. We separate them. Our most transferable result is that two natural ways of measuring the effect manufacture it from no underlying response: a cross-market comovement decline (−0.086, p = 0.005) that vanishes once the set of open instruments is held fixed, and an all-session cash-equity volume increase (+19%) that is extended-hours sampling. Each reproduces the prior finding from a process with no match effect, the comovement case shown general by a Monte Carlo. On one-minute data for eleven instruments across five market structures over 2018 and 2022, the aggregate channel is bounded near zero: equivalence tests reject a 30% effect in every group (declines beyond about 9% excluded in crypto spot, 6% pooled), and an injected 30–45% decline is recovered with full power, so these are genuine nulls, not weak tests. The local channel we bound rather than refute. No mapped venue we can reach shows a decline and the daily home response is bounded below about 11%; but the exact Ehrmann–Jansen object, a minute-level own-exchange trade count whose trader is the viewer, is left untested for want of free foreign intraday data. The next-day loser effect is absent at daily frequency in 20 national indices and 16 currencies. We do not overturn the distraction effect in its own setting; the contribution is the bound on the aggregate channel, the evidence that it does not travel to the venues that now carry most trading, and the two mechanisms that show how readily it is mismeasured.

AI.tldr: 本文研究世界杯这一全球注意力冲击对金融市场交易的影响，发现以往研究中报告的显著效应（国内交易所交易量减半）实际上是测量方法的人为产物。在11种金融工具、5种市场结构的高频数据中，全球渠道的影响接近于零；本地效应虽然存在但远小于先前估计。
AI.research_question: 世界杯这一全球同步的注意力冲击，是否真的如先前研究所表明的那样显著影响金融市场交易？全球渠道（无国家队映射的全球衍生品市场）和本地渠道（有国家队映射的交易所）分别受到多大影响？
AI.motivation: 已有研究（Ehrmann & Jansen）发现国家队比赛时本国交易所交易量减半，但这一发现可能混淆了本地效应和全球效应。当前大部分交易发生在全球、连续的衍生品市场，该市场中不存在"边际交易者"与国家队的对应关系，因此需要分离两个渠道并检验该效应是否具有可推广性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力冲击（attention shock）、交易者分心（distraction effect）、市场微观结构。
AI.method: 使用2018年和2022年世界杯期间11种金融工具（覆盖5种市场结构）的一分钟高频数据。采用等价检验（equivalence test）对效应大小进行边界估计；利用蒙特卡洛模拟证明"交叉市场协动性下降"是测量伪影；比较不同交易时间定义（全时段vs.延长时段采样）对结果的差异。
AI.findings: （1）全球渠道效应趋近于零：等价检验拒绝了所有组中30%以上的交易量下降效应（加密现货市场排除约9%以上的下降，合并数据排除6%以上）；（2）本地渠道效应远小于先前估计：可获取数据中未观察到交易量下降，日度数据中本国市场响应被限制在约11%以下；（3）两种常见测量方式会人为制造出效应：交叉市场协动性下降（-0.086, p=0.005）在固定开盘工具集后消失；全时段现金股票成交量增加（+19%）实际上是延长时段采样的产物；（4）次日的"输家效应"在20个国家指数和16种货币中均不存在。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了注意力冲击研究中一个重要的测量伪影问题，说明先前报告的显著效应可能是方法论的人为产物；（2）通过等价检验和效应边界估计，提供了"不显著"不等于"无证据"的严格统计论证；（3）区分了全球渠道和本地渠道，指出注意力冲击的金融影响具有边界条件，不能简单推广到不同市场结构。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对量化交易者和市场参与者而言，世界杯等大型体育赛事并不构成系统性的全球交易量冲击，无需为此调整交易策略；（2）对监管机构和交易所而言，研究结果提醒需谨慎解读赛事对市场质量的影响；（3）对方法论研究者而言，展示了两种常见的测量谬误及其纠正方法，具有方法论警示意义。

reference: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 6/2026
title: Heterogeneity in Consumers’ Economic Expectations across Euro Area Countries
affiliations: Leibniz University Hannover, , Leibniz  Universität Hannover and Bank of Finland - Research

detail.title: Heterogeneity in Consumers’ Economic Expectations across Euro Area Countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 6/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines cross-country differences in consumer expectations about macroeconomic outcomes and mortgage borrowing conditions within a monetary union. Using harmonized microdata from the ECB Consumer Expectations Survey for eleven euro area countries, we document significant national disparities. By sequentially adding a rich set of consumer- and country-specific macro controls to pooled regressions with country fixed effects, we find that these factors account for much, but not all, of the cross-country heterogeneity in expectations. These remaining differences likely reflect unobserved country specific factors, highlighting the need for country-tailored monetary policy communication to effectively stabilize consumer expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧元区11国消费者预期调查的微观数据，研究了货币联盟内消费者对宏观经济结果和抵押贷款借款条件的预期存在的跨国差异，发现即使控制了消费者个体和国家层面的宏观因素，国家固定效应仍无法完全解释这些差异，表明需要针对国别差异定制货币政策沟通。
AI.research_question: 货币联盟内，消费者对宏观经济结果和抵押贷款借款条件的预期是否存在显著的跨国差异？这些差异在多大程度上可由消费者个体特征和国家宏观因素解释？
AI.motivation: 在货币联盟（欧元区）中，各国消费者预期存在显著异质性，但现有研究对此缺乏系统性的微观证据。理解预期差异的来源对于制定有效的、针对不同国家的货币政策沟通策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者预期形成理论；货币政策传导机制中的预期渠道；国家特定因素（制度、文化、历史经验）对预期的影响。
AI.method: 利用欧洲央行消费者预期调查（ECB Consumer Expectations Survey）中11个欧元区国家的微观数据，通过逐步加入消费者个体控制变量和国家宏观控制变量的 pooled 回归模型（含国家固定效应），分析跨国预期差异的解释程度。
AI.findings: 消费者个体特征和国家宏观因素可以解释大部分跨国预期差异，但国家固定效应仍然显著，表明存在未被观测到的国家特定因素（如制度、文化、历史经验等）导致了预期的剩余异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币联盟内消费者预期异质性的来源提供了微观实证证据；丰富了关于货币政策传导机制中“预期渠道”的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：欧元区货币政策沟通不能“一刀切”，需要针对不同国家的特定情况采取定制化的沟通策略，以更有效地稳定消费者预期。

reference: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 7/2026
title: Corporate Debt Composition, Access to Credit, and Monetary Policy
affiliations: Bank of Finland - Research and Bank of Finland

detail.title: Corporate Debt Composition, Access to Credit, and Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 7/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In both the U.S. and the euro area, the share of market finance in aggregate corporate credit has grown over time. To study the implications of the corporate debt structure for the transmission of monetary policy, we develop a New Keynesian DSGE model in which firms differ in productivity and may finance themselves with either bonds or loans. Our setup makes the aggregate corporate debt composition and firms’ credit access endogenous and dependent on aggregate economic conditions. The model rationalizes the empirically documented substitution from bank loans to bond finance following a monetary policy con traction. Credit is squeezed for those bank-dependent firms that cannot access the bond market. A structural shift in the aggregate bond-to-loan ratio among credit-eligible firms affects financial market dynamics, but does not materially change the overall impact of monetary policy shocks on the macroeconomy. Instead, in an economy with greater credit access, aggregate demand is less responsive to monetary policy shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建新凯恩斯DSGE模型，研究企业债务结构（债券与贷款）对货币政策传导的影响。发现货币政策紧缩时，企业从贷款转向债券融资，但整体债务结构变化对宏观经济影响有限，而信贷可及性提高会削弱货币政策效果。
AI.research_question: 企业债务结构（债券融资 vs 银行贷款）如何影响货币政策的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 在美国和欧元区，市场融资在企业信贷中的占比持续上升，但企业债务结构对货币政策传导的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯DSGE模型，异质性企业（生产率差异），内生企业债务结构决策，信贷渠道理论。
AI.method: 构建包含异质性企业（可选择债券或贷款融资）的新凯恩斯DSGE模型，内生化企业债务结构与信贷可及性，进行数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1) 货币政策紧缩导致企业从银行贷款转向债券融资，与实证一致。2) 依赖银行的企业的信贷被压缩。3) 债券-贷款比率的结构性变化影响金融市场动态，但不显著改变货币政策对宏观经济的总体影响。4) 信贷可及性更高的经济体中，总需求对货币政策冲击的反应更弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业债务结构内生化纳入DSGE模型，揭示了企业融资选择对货币政策传导的差异化影响，特别是银行依赖型企业的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于企业债务结构变化如何影响货币政策有效性的洞见，提示应关注信贷可及性提高可能削弱货币政策效果的风险。

title: Atoms and Minds: On the Industrial Race Ahead of Us
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Atoms and Minds: On the Industrial Race Ahead of Us
detail.abstract: The public debate over artificial intelligence is conducted almost entirely in the vocabulary of software-benchmarks, parameters, model releases. This paper argues that the framing is mistaken. The contest for AI supremacy is an industrial contest, governed by two physical and human constraints that no algorithm can relax: electrical power and trained minds. Read through this lens, the present strategic picture is stark. China is building the inputs-approving roughly ten nuclear reactors in each of four consecutive years, holding the world's largest fleet under construction, and now producing close to half of the planet's elite AI researchers domestically. The United States is buying the inputs-constructing data centres at scale and importing talent through compensation packages that have reached, in one reported case, the better part of a billion dollars per individual: momentum that is real but rented. Europe is doing neither. A survey of the wider field-the Gulf, India, East Asia, and the Global South-finds the same logic everywhere: the serious builders couple energy to compute, and Europe appears on none of these maps. The paper develops this constraint-based account drawing on Smil, Perez, and Mazzucato; reframes the recurring "data centres consume too much water" narrative-and the live 2026 controversy over whether that narrative is foreign-financed-as a distraction variable; and closes with a normative proposal for a credible European response. The central claim is uncomfortable: the next decade of AI will be won by whoever keeps the lights on and grows the people-and on present trajectory, that is not Europe.

AI.tldr: 本文认为人工智能竞争的本质是工业竞争，受电力（物理约束）和人才（人力约束）两个核心因素驱动，而非算法或模型。当前格局下，中国在建设电力基础设施和培养本土AI人才方面领先，美国通过资本购买算力并高价吸引全球人才（但具有不可持续性），而欧洲在两方面均无所作为。作者提出欧洲应正视这一现实并制定可信的应对战略。
AI.research_question: 人工智能全球竞争的真实驱动力是什么？欧洲在AI领域的结构性劣势为何？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI的公共讨论几乎完全被软件、基准测试、参数、模型发布等技术话语主导，作者认为这种框架是误导性的，忽视了AI竞争背后的物理和人力约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Smil（能源与基础设施）、Perez（技术-经济范式）、Mazzucato（创新与国家角色）的理论传统，提出约束驱动（constraint-based）的分析框架。
AI.method: 理论与历史分析，结合全球能源基础设施数据、AI人才培养数据、产业战略比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 中国连续四年每年批准约十座核反应堆，拥有全球最大的在建核电舰队，且近半全球顶级AI研究人员在中国本土培养；2. 美国通过大规模建设数据中心和全球高价引进人才维持优势，但 momentum 是"租来的"而非可持续的；3. 欧洲在电力基础设施建设和AI人才培养上均无实质性行动；4. 海湾国家、印度、东亚、全球南方等其他地区也在遵循"能源+算力"耦合的逻辑，欧洲在这些地图上均不出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI竞争从软件/算法语境重新框定为工业竞争，引入能量基础设施和人力资本两个不可算法化的硬约束维度，批评"数据中心耗水"等叙事是"干扰变量"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者提供战略诊断框架，指出若不解决能源基础设施和AI人才培养两大瓶颈，欧洲将在未来十年的AI竞争中持续落后。

title: The Effect of Race, Gender and Priming on LLMs' Conviction Predictions
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law and University of California, Berkeley - School of Law

detail.title: The Effect of Race, Gender and Priming on LLMs' Conviction Predictions
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) could help overcome fundamental shortcomings in justice systems, by enhancing access to justice, supporting legal professionals, and ultimately promoting fairness and efficiency across legal frameworks. The hope that LLMs could improve judicial processes is tempered by concerns over AI fairness, with evidence of LLMs echoing biases deeply embedded in human cognition. This study audits the performance of two LLMs in the legal domain, specifically evaluating how a defendant's race and gender influence conviction predictions. It further tests models' sensitivity to implicit biases, measuring explicit versus implicit racial conditions using suggestive names, as well as the priming effect in AI, by introducing positive or negative context before the main prompt. We present findings from an experiment (N=17,324) in which we asked OpenAI's GPT-4 and 4o to predict conviction probabilities on a scale from 0% to 100%. Our overall 45 prompts were designed around a hypothetical criminal case scenario that had been used in prior studies with human judges, where we manipulated defendant attributes across a 3(gender) × 5(race) × 3(priming) experimental design. Our results demonstrate a small yet systematic influence of race and a clear priming effect in both tested models. Findings point to progressive bias, suggesting that both models may have undergone algorithmic debiasing.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验（N=17,324）审计了GPT-4和GPT-4o两个大型语言模型在法律领域的偏见表现，发现被告的种族和性别对定罪预测存在系统性影响，同时揭示了显著的启动效应，且模型可能存在算法去偏后的渐进偏见。
AI.research_question: 被告的种族和性别如何影响LLM在法律领域的定罪预测？LLM是否对隐性和显性偏见敏感？启动效应（上下文提示）是否会影响模型的判断？
AI.motivation: LLM有望提升司法系统的可及性、效率和公平性，但AI公平性令人担忧。已有证据表明LLM会反映人类社会认知中的深层偏见，因此有必要系统审计LLM在法律领域的偏见表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI偏见理论、隐性偏见理论、启动效应（priming effect）理论、算法去偏（algorithmic debiasing）理论
AI.method: 实验法：使用3（性别）× 5（种族）× 3（启动效应）的因子设计，设计45个提示词，基于先前用于人类法官研究的假设刑事案件场景，向GPT-4和GPT-4o询问0%-100%的定罪概率，样本量N=17,324。
AI.findings: 1）种族对定罪预测存在微小但系统性的影响；2）两模型均存在明显的启动效应；3）存在渐进偏见迹象，表明两模型可能经过了算法去偏处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 为LLM在法律领域的偏见研究提供了实证证据，揭示了AI偏见从显性向渐进形式演变的趋势，扩展了启动效应理论在AI语境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律科技应用中的AI公平性审计提供了方法论参考，警示法律从业者和政策制定者注意LLM在司法辅助中的潜在偏见风险，推动AI去偏技术的进一步发展。

title: Drinking Water Contamination and Home Prices: Evidence from California

detail.title: Drinking Water Contamination and Home Prices: Evidence from California

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received.

detail.abstract: Water systems in the U.S. are required to provide notifications to consumers when they detect elevated levels of contaminants in drinking water. This paper provides the first examination of the effects of nitrate contamination notifications on home prices in California, an issue that has impacted more than 1.4 million residents in affected water systems across the state. Using a robust difference-indifferences and event-study framework with ZIP-code level housing data from 2000 to 2024, I find that nitrate contamination notifications are associated with statistically significant declines in home prices of approximately 5.8 percent in the years following a notification. These estimates imply economic costs amounting to $212.5 million for an average-sized water system.

AI.tldr: 首次研究硝酸盐污染通知对加州房价的影响，发现通知发布后房价显著下降约5.8%，平均水系统经济损失达2.125亿美元。
AI.research_question: 硝酸盐污染通知如何影响加州房价？
AI.motivation: 美国水系统在检测到饮用水污染物超标时须向消费者发布通知，但此类通知的经济后果（尤其是房价影响）尚未得到系统研究。加州超过140万居民受此影响，研究其经济代价具有重要的政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尚未明确提及核心理论，但研究隐含基于信息经济学和资本化效应（环境污染信息→购房者风险认知→房价调整）。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年ZIP码级住房数据，采用双重差分（DID）和事件研究框架进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 硝酸盐污染通知与房价在通知后几年内显著下降约5.8%相关，平均水系统经济损失为2.125亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了饮用水污染通知的房地产资本化效应，拓展了环境规制信息披露经济后果的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了污染通知经济成本的具体估算，有助于评估现有通知政策的收益成本，并为水资源管理和住房市场监管提供参考。

title:
Hormuz to Harvest:
Food Impacts of the 2026 Gulf War
affiliations: , McMaster University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Hormuz to Harvest:
Food Impacts of the 2026 Gulf War
detail.abstract: The global food supply will be affected by the 2026 Gulf War that will cutoff one-third of global nitrogen fertilizer including third of urea supply at the onset of the Northern Hemisphere spring planting window. We investigate the agronomic cascade from fertilizer supply interruption to food production, suggesting that an aggregate fertilizer supply contraction of 57% of pre-crisis baseline is likely to drive a price spike of 1.75× ceiling and a total staple crop production loss of 222 Mt. Sensitivity analysis suggests that governance capacity is a major driver of the outcome variance, far above closure duration.

AI.tldr: 本文模拟了2026年海湾战争导致全球三分之一氮肥供应中断对粮食生产的级联影响。研究发现，化肥供应收缩57%将导致价格上涨1.75倍，主粮产量损失2.22亿吨。敏感性分析表明，治理能力是结果差异的主要驱动因素，远超封锁持续时间。
AI.research_question: 2026年海湾战争导致的氮肥供应中断将如何通过农业级联效应对全球粮食生产产生影响？
AI.motivation: 全球粮食安全面临地缘政治冲突带来的化肥供应中断风险，量化这种冲击的农业级联效应对于政策制定和危机应对具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业级联效应理论、化肥-粮食供应链传导机制、治理能力与危机韧性理论
AI.method: 情景模拟分析、敏感性分析，量化化肥供应收缩与粮食产量损失之间的关系
AI.findings: 化肥供应收缩57%将导致价格飙升1.75倍及主粮产量损失2.22亿吨；治理能力是影响结果差异的主导因素，重要性远超封锁持续时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了地缘政治冲击通过化肥供应链传导至粮食生产的级联效应机制，识别出治理能力作为关键调节变量的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球粮食安全政策制定者提供了危机情景下的风险预警和应对优先级建议，强调了提升治理能力在缓解粮食危机中的关键作用。

title: Technology Speed Limits
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Technology Speed Limits
detail.abstract: We study optimal technology regulation when private learning occurs both through doing (scaling up the technology) and through waiting (as time passes). We show that an adaptive speed limit-a cap on the rate at which the technology can increase per-unit time-delivers optimal worst-case guarantees over all learning processes and/or preferences, and is the only time-consistent mechanism that does so.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当私人学习同时通过实践（技术规模扩大）和等待（时间推移）发生时，最优技术监管问题。研究表明，适应性速度限制——对技术每单位时间增长率的限制——在所有学习过程和/或偏好下都能实现最优最坏情况保证，并且是唯一能做到这一点的时间一致性机制。
AI.research_question: 当私人学习同时通过"边做边学"（技术规模扩大）和"边等边学"（时间推移）发生时，如何设计最优技术监管政策？
AI.motivation: 现实中技术的私人学习过程复杂，既来源于生产实践中的经验积累，也来源于纯粹的时间流逝带来的知识增长。如何在这种双重学习机制下设计能够应对不确定性的最优监管政策，是一个重要的理论和实践问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优监管理论、学习理论、机制设计理论、时间一致性理论
AI.method: 理论建模和博弈论分析，研究最优最坏情况保证下的监管机制设计
AI.findings: 适应性速度限制（对技术每单位时间增长率的限制）在所有学习过程和/或偏好下都能实现最优最坏情况保证，并且是唯一具备时间一致性的此类机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将双重私人学习机制（边做边学和边等边学）纳入最优技术监管分析框架；证明了适应性速度限制在时间一致性和最优最坏情况保证方面的独特优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体可行的技术监管工具——适应性速度限制，帮助在技术不确定性下实现稳健的最优监管。

reference: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
title: Toward a New Research Agenda for Artificial Intelligence and International Law
affiliations: Texas A&M University School of Law

detail.title: Toward a New Research Agenda for Artificial Intelligence and International Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Over the past few years, artificial intelligence—in particular, generative AI—and the changes brought about by this new technology have garnered priority attention from policymakers, commentators, and the mass media. Issues such as job displacement, the unauthorized use of personal information and likeness, the protection of intellectual property rights, and environmental sustainability have attracted analyses through an AI lens. What is less explored, however, is how AI will change the future development of international law. 

To provide an overview of the issues that have received attention thus far and that will continue to emerge at the intersection of AI and international law, this short essay, which was expanded from the opening remarks on the “Artificial Intelligence and the Boundaries of International Law” panel at International Law Weekend—West 2026, identifies eight issues that deserve greater policy and scholarly engagement. Together, these issues help demonstrate the need for a new research agenda for AI and international law and provide content to fill this agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，尽管AI（尤其是生成式AI）对就业、隐私、知识产权和环境影响等问题已受到广泛关注，但其对国际法未来发展的影响却探讨不足。作者从2026年国际法周末西部会议的发言扩展而来，提出了八个值得政策界和学术界进一步关注的议题，呼吁建立AI与国际法的新研究议程。
AI.research_question: 人工智能将如何改变国际法的未来发展？哪些议题亟需政策界和学术界的更多关注？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI的讨论多集中于就业、隐私、知识产权和环境等问题，但AI对国际法的影响尚未得到充分探讨，因此需要提出新的研究议程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法理论、AI治理框架、新兴技术与国际法规范的交叉研究。
AI.method: 基于会议发言扩展的短评/观点文章，通过识别和归纳八个关键议题来构建分析框架。
AI.findings: 识别出八个值得关注的AI与国际法交叉议题，并论证了建立新研究议程的必要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与国际法的交叉研究提供了系统性的议题框架，推动了国际法理论在新兴技术背景下的拓展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际法学者提供了八个具体的研究和政策关注方向，有助于引导未来AI国际治理的议程设置。

title: Is the AfCFTA Investment Protocol Fit for the Fifth Industrial Revolution? Defining and Protecting Digital Assets in Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Is the AfCFTA Investment Protocol Fit for the Fifth Industrial Revolution? Defining and Protecting Digital Assets in Africa
detail.abstract: The AfCFTA Investment Protocol was negotiated against the backdrop of an accelerating digital transformation, where value is increasingly derived from intangible assets such as data, algorithms, and digital platforms. This paper critically assesses the Protocol's readiness to govern investment in the digital economy, a sector pivotal for Africa's development but fraught with regulatory challenges. It argues that the Protocol's relatively traditional definition of investment and its asset-based protections may be ill-equipped to address the unique characteristics of digital assets, creating significant legal uncertainty for investors and regulators alike. The paper examines three core areas of tension. First, it analyses whether cross-border data flows, cloud computing infrastructure, and artificial intelligence systems can be unequivocally classified and protected as covered investments under the Protocol. Second, it investigates the compatibility of the Protocol's provisions with the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol, particularly concerning data localisation measures and digital sovereignty. Third, it questions the suitability of the investor-state dispute settlement mechanism, the design of which remains subject to ongoing negotiation pursuant to Article 46 of the Protocol, for resolving complex, technology-driven disputes. By highlighting these potential regulatory gaps, the paper contends that without a forwardlooking interpretation by arbitral tribunals or subsequent explicit amendments, the Protocol risks failing to provide the legal certainty needed to attract high-value digital investment.

AI.tldr: 本文批评性评估AfCFTA投资议定书在数字经济时代治理投资方面的准备程度，指出其传统投资定义和资产保护模式难以适应数字资产（数据、算法、AI等）的特性，可能导致法律不确定性，进而阻碍高价值数字投资进入非洲。
AI.research_question: AfCFTA投资议定书是否能够有效治理数字经济投资？其现有框架是否存在法律不确定性和监管空白？
AI.motivation: 数字经济正加速转型，非洲数据、算法、数字平台等无形资产价值日益凸显，但现有投资议定书的传统框架难以应对数字资产的独特性，亟需评估其准备程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资法中的"投资定义"理论；资产保护理论；数字主权与数据本地化理论；投资者-国家争端解决机制理论。
AI.method: 规范分析/法律批判分析，通过审视投资议定书条款与数字贸易议定书的兼容性，以及争端解决机制的设计，识别监管空白。
AI.findings: 1）跨境数据流、云计算基础设施和AI系统难以明确被归类为受保护投资；2）投资议定书与数字贸易议定书在数据本地化和数字主权条款上存在不兼容；3）投资者-国家争端解决机制不适合解决复杂技术驱动的争端；4）若仲裁庭不进行前瞻性解释或无后续修订，议定书将无法提供吸引数字投资所需的法律确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统国际投资法框架在数字经济时代面临的适应性危机，为数字资产如何纳入国际投资法保护提供了批判性理论反思。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AfCFPA政策制定者、仲裁庭及投资者提供了关于如何弥合投资议定书与数字经济现实之间差距的具体建议，包括前瞻性仲裁解释和后续条款修订的必要性。

reference: GMU Working Paper in Economics Vol. 50; Case Western Reserve Law Review, Vol. 50, pp. 351–420 (1999)
title: The Manne Programs in Economics for Federal Judges
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: The Manne Programs in Economics for Federal Judges

publicationDetails.detailsText: GMU Working Paper in Economics Vol. 50
publicationDetails.journalName: George Mason University Department of Economics Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Case Western Reserve Law Review, Vol. 50, pp. 351–420 (1999)

detail.abstract:
For over twenty years, Henry G. Manne developed and directed educational programs in economics for federal judges.
