title: North Korea's Economic Strategy Shift amid the Polycrisis: Performance and Outlook
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: North Korea's Economic Strategy Shift amid the Polycrisis: Performance and Outlook

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 334
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Since 2018, North Korea has faced an unprecedented triple isolation. The international community's severe sanctions, diplomatic deadlock following the collapse of the 2019 Hanoi summit, and border closures coupled with the COVID-19 pandemic from early 2020 have simultaneously pressured the North Korean economy. This polycrisis sharply contracted North Korea's external trade, cut off foreign currency income sources, and dealt serious shocks to the internal economy through material shortages and supply chain disruptions. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文分析2018年以来朝鲜面临制裁、外交僵局与疫情三重孤立叠加的“多元危机”，探讨其对朝鲜经济造成的贸易萎缩、外汇枯竭及内部供应链冲击等影响。
AI.research_question: 2018年以来朝鲜面临的三重孤立（制裁、外交僵局、疫情）如何叠加冲击其经济？
AI.motivation: 理解朝鲜在多重外部压力下的经济脆弱性，以及“多元危机”对封闭经济的独特影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元危机（polycrisis）理论、国际制裁经济学、封闭经济体外部冲击传导机制。
AI.method: 定性分析，结合贸易数据、政策文件与案例研究，考察制裁、外交与疫情三重压力的协同效应。
AI.findings: 三重孤立导致朝鲜对外贸易急剧萎缩、外汇收入来源被切断，并通过物资短缺与供应链中断对内部经济造成严重冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了多元危机理论在封闭小国经济体中的应用，揭示多重外部压力叠加的非线性经济后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会评估对朝制裁效果提供参考，提示人道主义豁免与危机管理的重要性。

title: Agent Experience: A Measurable Approach to Machine-Operable Environments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Agent Experience: A Measurable Approach to Machine-Operable Environments
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Agent Experience (AX) as a measurable approach to evaluating environments for autonomous and semi-autonomous software agents. AX treats the machine-facing environment as an analytically distinct object of study, separate from human-facing interface design. User Experience (UX) measures the quality of screen-mediated human interaction; AX measures the quality of signal-mediated machine interaction. The paper defines AX as the measurable quality of an environment for software agents, operationalized through discoverability, signal clarity, executable affordances, protocol interoperability, identity verification, consent, auditability, cost attribution, and outcome verification. The approach draws on information-field theory and institutional analysis, where environments are treated as structured fields through which signals propagate and where divergence between declared rules and observed behavior can be measured as institutional anomie. AX is grounded in observable evidence from existing standards and protocols, including Agent-to-Agent (A2A) for peer-agent coordination, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool and context integration, OpenAPI for service description, Schema.org Actions for web affordances, W3C Decentralized Identifiers and Verifiable Credentials for identity and claims, OpenTelemetry for traces, and NIST AI RMF for governance. The paper develops an AX measurement model, adds token-and tool-level cost modeling, maps protocol layers, compares registry implementations, and applies the approach to browser-based platforms, structured tender environments, and agent-native commerce. The contribution is theoretical, operational, and measurable: AX provides a vocabulary and method for asking how suitable an environment is for agents to complete real tasks under explicit policy, identity, cost, and consent constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"智能体体验"（Agent Experience, AX）这一可测量的概念，用于评估自主和半自主软件智能体所处的环境质量。AX将机器端环境作为独立于人类界面设计的分析对象，借鉴信息场理论与制度分析，通过可发现性、信号清晰度、可执行可供性、协议互操作性、身份验证、同意、可审计性、成本归属和结果验证等维度来操作化测量。文章结合A2A、MCP、OpenAPI、Schema.org Actions、W3C DID/VC、OpenTelemetry和NIST AI RMF等现有标准与协议，建立了AX测量模型、成本建模、协议层映射与注册表比较，并将该方法应用于浏览器平台、结构化招标环境和智能体原生电商等场景。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可操作、可测量的框架来评估软件智能体所处环境的质量？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个系统化的方法来衡量"机器端环境"对智能体完成任务的支持程度。用户体验（UX）专注于人类交互，但智能体与环境的交互（信号介导）与传统屏幕介导的人机交互有本质区别，需要一个独立的概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息场理论（information-field theory）、制度分析（institutional analysis）、制度失范（institutional anomie）——将环境视为结构化信号传播场域，并以声明规则与实际行为之间的偏离来测量制度失范。
AI.method: 理论构建与框架设计，结合现有标准和协议（A2A、MCP、OpenAPI、Schema.org Actions、W3C DID/VC、OpenTelemetry、NIST AI RMF）进行实证映射，建立AX测量模型和成本模型，并通过浏览器平台、结构化招标环境和智能体原生电商三个应用场景进行验证。
AI.findings: 提出了一套包含九个关键维度的AX测量框架；建立了token级和工具级的成本归因模型；绘制了协议分层映射；比较了不同注册表实现；在三个应用场景中展示了AX框架的分析能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"智能体体验"（AX）确立为与用户体验（UX）并列的分析范畴，为信息场理论和制度分析在AI智能体环境评估中的应用提供了可操作化的路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者、协议开发者和政策制定者提供了评估和改进机器端环境的具体工具和指标体系，有助于构建更加可发现、可互操作、可审计且符合治理要求的智能体生态。

title: From National Quality Infrastructure to Productivity in Emerging Asia: Evidence from Vietnam
affiliations: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation, Ministry of Science and Technology, Vietnam, CSIRO Data61, Hanoi University of Science and Technology and Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation

detail.title: From National Quality Infrastructure to Productivity in Emerging Asia: Evidence from Vietnam
detail.abstract: Quality infrastructure, comprising metrology, standardisation, conformity assessment, and accreditation, is increasingly recognised as an institutional and technical foundation for sustainable productivity growth. National Quality Infrastructure (NQI) enhances economic performance through multiple channels, including increasing market access, reducing information asymmetry, and supporting technology diffusion. However, existing empirical studies mainly focus on individual components and provide limited quantitative evidence on the macroeconomic contribution of integrated NQI systems, particularly in emerging Asian economies. This study develops the first Vietnam Quality Infrastructure Index (VQII) to measure the evolution of Vietnam’s NQI capacity over the period 2000–2023 using grounded indicators that reflect the country’s institutional context. Using a dynamic autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) framework, the study finds a positive and statistically significant lagged relationship between VQII and total factor productivity growth. The findings suggest that the productivity effects of NQI development are gradual and become more evident after approximately three years. The results highlight the importance of long-term and coordinated investment in standards, metrology, accreditation, and conformity assessment systems as part of broader productivity enhancement and industrial upgrading strategies in emerging Asian economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了首个越南质量基础设施指数（VQII），采用动态ARDL模型发现NQI对全要素生产率增长存在约三年的滞后期正向影响，为新兴亚洲经济体提供了系统性量化证据。
AI.research_question: 新兴亚洲经济体中，国家质量基础设施（NQI）的综合体系对宏观经济（尤其是全要素生产率增长）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有实证研究多聚焦于NQI的单个组件（如计量、标准化等），缺乏对综合性NQI体系宏观经济贡献的量化证据，尤其在新兴亚洲经济体领域存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家质量基础设施（NQI）理论；质量基础设施作为制度与技术基础促进可持续生产率增长的理论。
AI.method: 构建越南质量基础设施指数（VQII，2000-2023年）；采用动态自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型进行时间序列分析。
AI.findings: VQII与全要素生产率增长之间存在正向且统计显著的滞后关系；NQI的生产率效应约在三年后逐渐显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为越南构建综合性的NQI指数，弥补了新兴亚洲经济体NQI宏观量化研究的不足；揭示了NQI对生产率具有滞后性影响，丰富了发展经济学与制度经济学的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议新兴亚洲经济体进行长期、协调的标准化、计量、认证和认可体系投资，作为产业升级和生产率提升战略的关键组成部分。

title: More Than Just a Game? Soccer Tournaments and Firm Sentiment
affiliations: Ifo Institute and Ifo Institute

detail.title: More Than Just a Game? Soccer Tournaments and Firm Sentiment

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides the first systematic firm-level analysis of how major international football tournaments affect business sentiment. We combine 2.2 million responses from the ifo Business Survey with information on 17 FIFA World Cups and UEFA European Championships between 1991 and 2024 and estimate event-study models around each tournament. Our results reveal a pronounced asymmetry: firms' assessments of their current business situation barely respond to tournaments, whereas the probability of reporting better business expectations rises by around six percentage points two months before a tournament starts, remaining elevated well into the post-tournament period. The anticipation effect is strongest in manufacturing, while trade is the only sector in which the current situation also improves, consistent with tangible tournament-related demand. The European Championship, played on the continent, lifts both sentiment dimensions, whereas the World Cup operates almost exclusively through expectations. Comparing the 2006 World Cup (hosted), the 2014 World Cup (won), and the EURO2024 (hosted), we find that strong public engagement and a supportive macroeconomic environment, rather than hosting status, drive the sentiment response. A placebo test and an alternative dummy assignment based on exact survey participation dates support the interpretation that the documented effects are genuinely tied to the tournaments rather than to seasonal or cyclical patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1991-2024年间220万份ifo商业调查数据，结合17届国际足球赛事，首次从企业层面系统分析了重大足球赛事如何影响商业情绪。研究发现：企业对当前经营状况的评估几乎不受赛事影响，但商业预期在赛前两个月上升约6个百分点，并持续到赛后；这种预期效应在制造业最强，而贸易部门是唯一当前状况也改善的行业；欧洲杯提振了情绪的两个维度，而世界杯主要通过预期发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 重大国际足球赛事（FIFA世界杯和UEFA欧洲杯）如何影响企业的商业情绪（包括当前经营状况评估和未来商业预期）？
AI.motivation: 足球赛事是全球最受关注的体育事件之一，会产生巨大的经济影响，但已有研究多聚焦于宏观层面（如股市、消费），缺乏对企业层面微观情绪的系统性分析。该文利用独特的德国ifo商业调查数据填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究模型（event-study models），结合商业情绪的双维度（当前状况评估 vs. 未来预期）框架，并引入"预期效应"（anticipation effect）概念。
AI.method: 基于1991-2024年间17届FIFA世界杯和UEFA欧洲杯赛事信息，与220万份ifo商业调查问卷数据匹配，采用事件研究法（event-study）估计赛事前后的情绪变化模式，并进行安慰剂检验和基于问卷日期的替代赋值检验。
AI.findings: （1）商业情绪存在显著的不对称性：当前状况评估几乎不受影响，而商业预期在赛前两个月上升约6个百分点，并持续到赛后；（2）预期效应在制造业最强；（3）贸易是唯一当前经营状况也改善的行业；（4）欧洲杯同时提升两个维度，世界杯几乎只通过预期发挥作用；（5）公众参与度和宏观经济环境比主办国身份更能驱动情绪反应。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从企业微观层面系统量化足球赛事对商业情绪的因果效应；（2）揭示了商业情绪双维度（当前状况与预期）对重大事件反应的异质性；（3）区分了不同赛事类型（世界杯vs.欧洲杯）、不同行业和不同主办/夺冠情境下的差异化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业管理者提供赛事期间商业预期波动的预警和决策参考；（2）为政策制定者评估大型体育赛事的经济影响提供微观证据；（3）帮助理解公众情绪与商业信心之间的传导机制。

title: No Calm Before the Storm: Typhoons, Shipping, and Trade
affiliations: Musashi University, ,  and

detail.title: No Calm Before the Storm: Typhoons, Shipping, and Trade

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Extreme weather is becoming more frequent and severe worldwide, yet its consequences for global trade channels remain an open question. This paper quantifies the cost of extreme weather to maritime trade. Integrating daily typhoon wind-swath data with hundreds of thousands of vessel voyages in Japanese waters, we document that maritime traffic falls by up to roughly 50% on typhoon-exposed open-ocean cells and by about 7% at typhoon-exposed ports. A voyage-level framework identifies $119 million in direct shipping-industry costs over 2013–2021. This disruption implies a total trade-volume welfare loss of $117.8 million. Combining the two channels yields a central total welfare estimate of approximately $237 million. As climate change intensifies, the invisible costs associated with increased extreme weather will scale accordingly, highlighting a vital dimension of climate risk that remains overlooked by adaptation frameworks focused solely on catastrophic land-based destruction.

AI.tldr: 本文量化极端天气对全球海上贸易的影响。通过整合台风路径数据与日本水域数十万次船舶航行的数据，研究发现台风使开放海域的海上交通量下降约50%，港口下降约7%。2013-2021年间，航运行业直接成本为1.19亿美元，贸易量福利损失为1.178亿美元，总福利损失约2.37亿美元。随着气候变化加剧，这一隐性成本将持续上升，凸显了当前仅关注陆地灾害的适应性框架所忽视的重要气候风险维度。
AI.research_question: 极端天气对全球海上贸易渠道的经济成本有多大？
AI.motivation: 极端天气日益频繁和严重，但其对全球贸易渠道的影响尚未被充分量化，现有适应性框架仅关注灾难性的陆地破坏，忽视了海上贸易的隐性气候风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易中断成本理论、气候风险经济评估框架
AI.method: 整合每日台风风场数据与日本水域数十万次船舶航行的微观数据，分别从开放海域和港口两个维度进行实证分析，并构建航行级框架估算直接成本和贸易量福利损失。
AI.findings: 台风暴露使开放海域的海上交通量下降约50%，港口下降约7%；2013-2021年航运行业直接成本为1.19亿美元，贸易量福利损失为1.178亿美元，总福利损失约2.37亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化极端天气对海上贸易的经济成本，填补了气候风险研究中忽视海上贸易渠道的空白，揭示了气候变化隐性成本的重要维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和航运行业提供了极端天气对贸易影响的量化依据，提示现有适应性框架需纳入海上贸易风险，以应对气候变化加剧带来的挑战。

title: The First Exploratory Analysis Comparing Gender Identity with Sex assigned at Birth on Food Calorie Perception Accuracy
affiliations: University of California, Bajec Senseworks and Brown University

detail.title: The First Exploratory Analysis Comparing Gender Identity with Sex assigned at Birth on Food Calorie Perception Accuracy
detail.abstract: Food calorie estimation accuracy remains poor despite the prevalence of caloric labeling and decades of public health efforts to educate US consumers. Research on this topic comparing performance based on traditional sex differences has yielded mixed results. No study to date has examined how gender identity in comparison to sex assigned at birth (SAAB) impacts calorie perception accuracy. To explore this question, 348 individuals aged 18-23 provided their SAAB and current gender identity and estimated the calories in nine sweet and savory restaurant menu item descriptions using 100-calorie increments. Accuracy categorized by SAAB revealed minimal differences. By contrast, when the data were segmented by gender identity more heterogeneous point estimates were observed with gender-diverse participants distinguished by highest accuracy and transgender participants distinguished by lowest accuracy. Different patterns were also observed as a function of how accuracy was defined, food flavor profile (sweet v. savory) and the specific foods assessed. Gender identity reveals important and until now unknown insights into food calorie perception and brings awareness to groups at risk for unhealthy eating behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次探讨性别认同（而非出生指定性别）如何影响食物卡路里感知准确性。研究发现，性别多样化群体准确性最高，跨性别群体准确性最低，而按出生指定性别分类则差异极小。
AI.research_question: 性别认同（相对于出生指定性别）如何影响食物卡路里感知准确性？
AI.motivation: 尽管卡路里标签和公共卫生教育已推行数十年，食物卡路里估算准确性仍然很差，且以往基于生理性别差异的研究结果不一致，尚无研究考察性别认同的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别认同理论；卡路里感知与饮食行为的关系；社会身份对认知判断的影响。
AI.method: 348名18-23岁参与者提供出生指定性别和当前性别认同，以100卡路里为增量估算9种甜/咸餐厅菜品描述的卡路里含量。
AI.findings: 按出生指定性别分类时差异极小；按性别认同分类时呈现显著异质性：性别多样化参与者准确性最高，跨性别参与者准确性最低。准确性模式因定义方式、风味（甜vs咸）和具体食物而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示性别认同（而非生理性别）是卡路里感知的重要解释变量，扩展了饮食行为研究中性别维度的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出跨性别群体为不健康饮食行为的高风险人群，为精准营养干预和公共健康教育提供新方向。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-45
title: Credit Risk Externalities: Evidence from European Non-Performing Loan Spillovers
affiliations: University of Greenwich, Athens University of Economics and Business and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Credit Risk Externalities: Evidence from European Non-Performing Loan Spillovers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-45
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines ex-post credit-risk externalities in Europe by quantifying crosscountry spillovers in non-performing loan (NPL) dynamics across 30 European countries over 2010Q1-2022Q2. Using a multilateral connectedness framework, we document three facts. First, spillovers are substantial: the static total connectedness index is 77.51%, indicating strong system-wide interdependence in realised credit risk. Second, NPL spillover directions are asymmetric: 18 countries are net receivers and 12 are net transmitters, where network evidence reveals a hub-and-periphery structure in which several highly connected nodes are not the economies with persistently high NPL ratios or acute domestic stress. Third, interconnectedness is persistent: dynamic rolling estimates remain elevated (typically 86-92%) and are comparatively smoother during 2019-2021, consistent with COVID-19 pandemic-era interventions dampening short-run fluctuations without dampening spillovers. Panel evidence links spillover roles to trade openness, GDP growth, and supervisory capacity: more open economies tend to be stronger net transmitters, while higher GDP growth and stronger supervisory capacity are associated with weaker net transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了30个欧洲国家2010-2022年间不良贷款（NPL）动态的跨境溢出效应，发现系统性互联性高达77.51%，存在核心-边缘网络结构，且溢出效应具有持久性和不对称性。贸易开放度、GDP增长和监管能力是决定国家净溢出角色的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 欧洲国家间不良贷款（NPL）动态是否存在显著的跨境溢出效应？溢出方向是否对称？哪些因素决定各国的净溢出角色？
AI.motivation: 欧洲各国信贷风险高度关联，但以往研究缺乏对不良贷款跨境溢出效应的系统性量化证据，尤其是溢出方向的不对称性和决定因素尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边关联性框架（multilateral connectedness framework）；核心-边缘网络结构理论；信贷风险跨境溢出理论。
AI.method: 采用多边关联性框架，对30个欧洲国家2010Q1-2022Q2的不良贷款动态进行静态和动态滚动估计，并辅以面板回归检验溢出角色的决定因素。
AI.findings: （1）静态总关联性指数为77.51%，显示系统层面信贷风险高度相互依存；（2）溢出方向不对称：18个净接收国 vs 12个净输出国，网络呈现核心-边缘结构，高度连接节点并非国内NPL比率高或压力大的国家；（3）动态估计显示互联性持续高位（86-92%），2019-2021年疫情期间波动平滑，但溢出效应未减弱；（4）贸易开放度越高越倾向于净输出，GDP增长越高和监管能力越强则净输出越弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化欧洲国家间不良贷款的跨境溢出效应，揭示了信贷风险互联性的核心-边缘网络结构，并识别了溢出不对称性的驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲监管机构提供了跨境信贷风险监测的量化工具；提示疫情期间干预措施虽平滑短期波动但未降低系统性互联风险，需关注贸易开放和监管能力对风险溢出的调节作用。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-46
title: Do Banks Price Pollution Risk?
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department Finance, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics,  and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Do Banks Price Pollution Risk?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-46
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines when and how pollution risk is priced in bank loan markets. Using toxic emission intensity as a proxy, we find that pollution risk has little effect on loan spreads in non–stress-testing periods, while conventional credit risk is strongly priced. When firms’ relationship banks are subject to regulatory stress testing, pollution risk becomes significantly priced, with spread effects comparable to a one- to two-notch credit-rating downgrade. The repricing is strongest for banks with tighter post-stress capital positions and stronger environmental orientation, yet higher spreads do not translate into subsequent reductions in emissions. These findings align with our state-dependent lending model, which adapts the intermediary asset pricing perspective to credit by linking loan risk premia to intermediary capital scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了污染风险何时以及如何在银行贷款市场中被定价。研究发现，在非压力测试期间，污染风险对贷款利差影响很小，而传统信用风险则被强制定价；但当企业的关系银行受到监管压力测试时，污染风险会显著被定价，其利差效应相当于信用评级下调1-2个等级。这种重新定价在压力后资本状况更紧张且环境导向更强的银行中最为显著，但较高的利差并未转化为后续的减排效果。
AI.research_question: 污染风险何时以及如何在银行贷款市场中被定价？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注信用风险定价，而对环境风险（特别是污染风险）在银行贷款市场中的定价机制缺乏深入理解。本文旨在探究污染风险被定价的条件和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中介资产定价视角，将贷款风险溢价与中介资本稀缺性联系起来，提出了一个状态依赖的贷款模型，解释污染风险定价的时变特征。
AI.method: 使用有毒排放强度作为污染风险的代理变量，利用银行贷款数据，对比分析压力测试与非压力测试期间污染风险对贷款利差的影响，并探讨银行特征（资本状况、环境导向）的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1) 非压力测试期间，污染风险对贷款利差影响很小；2) 当关系银行受监管压力测试时，污染风险显著被定价，效应相当于信用评级下调1-2个等级；3) 重新定价在资本状况更紧张和环境导向更强的银行中更显著；4) 较高利差并未带来后续减排。
AI.theory_contributions: 将中介资产定价视角扩展到信贷市场，提出状态依赖的贷款定价模型，揭示了污染风险定价的时变特征及其与银行资本稀缺性的内在联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估压力测试的溢出效应提供了新证据，提示银行在环境风险管理中的行为特征，以及高污染企业融资成本上升但并未有效促进减排的难题。

title: Consumption Responses to Rising Mortgage Rates: Unpacking the Cash-Flow Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics, , Danske Bank and University of Oxford - Oxford University Centre for Business Taxation

detail.title: Consumption Responses to Rising Mortgage Rates: Unpacking the Cash-Flow Channel of Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the transmission of rising interest rates to consumption using granular customer data from a major bank in Denmark. We show that households with adjustable-rate mortgages gradually reduced spending and increased deposits as market rates soared in 2022 but made no further spending cuts when their mortgage rates eventually reset to a higher level in 2023-2024. These patterns are consistent with forward-looking households who respond to new information about future mortgage costs and use liquid buffers to smooth consumption. The cash-flow channel of monetary policy may therefore operate almost instantaneously even when mortgage rates reset with a significant lag.

AI.tldr: 利用丹麦大型银行的客户数据，研究发现浮动利率抵押贷款家庭在2022年市场利率飙升时逐步减少支出、增加存款，但在2023-2024年抵押贷款利率实际重置后并未进一步削减开支。这符合前瞻性家庭利用流动性缓冲平滑消费的行为，表明货币政策的现金流渠道即使在利率重置存在显著滞后的情况下也可能几乎瞬时发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 利率上升如何通过现金流渠道传导至家庭消费？具体而言，当抵押贷款利率重置存在时滞时，家庭消费行为如何调整？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，只有抵押贷款利率实际重置后，家庭现金流才会受到挤压并影响消费。然而，如果家庭是前瞻性的，他们可能在预期未来利率上升时提前调整消费。本文旨在区分这两种机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前瞻性消费理论（永久收入假说/生命周期理论）、货币政策的现金流渠道。
AI.method: 利用丹麦一家大型银行的客户级别微观数据，采用事件研究法，比较2022年市场利率上升期（利率预期变化但未重置）与2023-2024年利率实际重置期前后家庭的消费和储蓄行为。
AI.findings: （1）浮动利率抵押贷款家庭在2022年市场利率飙升时已逐步减少支出、增加存款；（2）当2023-2024年抵押贷款利率实际重置到更高水平后，这些家庭并未进一步削减消费。这表明消费调整发生在利率预期变化阶段，而非实际重置阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了货币政策的现金流渠道必须通过实际利率重置才能影响消费的传统观点，证明了预期渠道在现金流传导中的核心作用，拓展了对货币政策传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行和监管机构具有重要政策含义：加息对消费的抑制作用可能比预期更早显现（即使贷款利率尚未重置），因此货币政策制定者应关注利率预期的变化，而非仅关注实际利率调整的时点。

title: Term Premia in China Sovereign Bonds

detail.title: Term Premia in China Sovereign Bonds
detail.abstract: This paper estimates term premia in China sovereign bonds and asks how far movements in the yield curve should be interpreted as revisions to expected future short rates rather than changes in compensation for bearing duration risk. I estimate a three-factor Gaussian affine term-structure model on monthly ChinaBond zero-coupon yields from one month to thirty years between October 2009 and March 2026. The model implies a term-premium component that is close to zero at the very short end and rises with maturity. The central empirical result is that the decomposition is not equally credible across the curve. At maturities from roughly one to six years, the expected-rate component tracks realized future short rates more closely than simple yield benchmarks, and the model-implied premium forecasts subsequent bond excess returns. At seven to ten years, the same evidence becomes weaker, less stable across subsamples, and more sensitive to observable curve slopes. The paper therefore contributes a disciplined estimate of China sovereign term premia together with explicit maturity-specific credibility margins. The main implication is that medium-maturity China yields contain separable expectations and risk-premium information, whereas the far long end is better interpreted as a benchmark pricing object than as a sharply identified measure of expected policy or duration risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用三因子高斯仿射期限结构模型，估计了中国主权债券的期限溢价，并指出收益率曲线不同期限的预期利率与风险溢价分解的可信度存在显著差异：1-6年期分解可信，7-10年期则较弱且不稳定。
AI.research_question: 中国主权债券收益率曲线的变动在多大程度上应被解释为对未来短期利率预期的修正，而非对持有久期风险补偿的变化？
AI.motivation: 准确分解收益率曲线中的预期成分与风险溢价成分对于货币政策传导评估、债券定价及风险管理具有重要意义，但现有研究对中国债券市场这一分解的可信度缺乏系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三因子高斯仿射期限结构模型（Gaussian Affine Term-Structure Model）。
AI.method: 利用2009年10月至2026年3月期间的中债登零息收益率数据（1个月至30年期），估计三因子高斯仿射期限结构模型，并对不同期限的分解结果进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1) 期限溢价在短端接近于零，随期限增长而上升；(2) 1-6年期，预期利率成分能更紧密地追踪未来实际短期利率，模型隐含的溢价能预测后续债券超额收益；(3) 7-10年期，上述证据变弱、跨子样本不稳定，且对 observable 曲线斜率更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了中国主权债券期限溢价的系统性估计，并首次明确了各期限分解结果的可信度边界，揭示了不同期限段信息含量的结构性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 中期中国债券收益率包含可分离的预期信息和风险溢价信息，而超长期端更适合作为基准定价对象，而非对预期政策或久期风险的精确度量。

title: Does Global Financial Transparency Improve Tax Compliance in Developing Countries?
affiliations: University of Oxford - Oxford University Centre for Business Taxation,  and University of Muenster

detail.title: Does Global Financial Transparency Improve Tax Compliance in Developing Countries?

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In a coordinated effort to curb tax evasion, governments systematically exchange information about bank accounts with foreign owners. We study the compliance effects of the policy in the context of South Africa using information reports on 1 million foreign bank accounts linked to income and audit data. We find that self-reported foreign income increased sharply and persistently at the onset of information exchange, but remained much below the true foreign income implied by the information reports. We explain the partial compliance response by showing that, contrary to standard theory of third-party reporting, the detection risk associated with non-compliance was modest.

AI.tldr: 利用南非100万个外国银行账户的信息报告数据，研究发现信息交换政策虽然显著且持续地提高了外国收入的自报告比例，但由于违规检测风险较低，自报告收入仍远低于真实外国收入水平。
AI.research_question: 政府间自动信息交换政策如何影响纳税人的逃税行为合规程度？
AI.motivation: 各国政府协调行动交换外国银行账户信息以遏制逃税，但该政策的实际合规效果尚需实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第三方报告理论（third-party reporting theory）——该理论认为第三方信息报告能有效提升纳税合规，但本文发现其前提条件（充分的检测风险）在现实中未必成立。
AI.method: 使用南非100万个外国银行账户的信息报告数据，匹配收入数据和审计数据，采用实证分析方法评估政策效果。
AI.findings: （1）信息交换政策启动后，自报告外国收入显著且持续增加；（2）但自报告收入仍远低于信息报告显示的真实外国收入；（3）部分合规的原因是违规检测风险较低，这与标准第三方报告理论的预测相悖。
AI.theory_contributions: 对第三方报告理论进行重要修正：揭示了该理论有效运作的前提条件——即需要有足够高的违规检测风险；当检测风险不足时，第三方信息报告只能带来部分合规效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府评估和优化自动信息交换政策提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需配套增强检测和执法力度，才能充分发挥信息交换的威慑作用。

title: BOOK REVIEW of Extralegal Governance: The Social Order of Illegal Markets in China, by Peng Wang and Wanlin Lin (Cambridge University Press, 2025). Forthcoming in the China Journal (University of Chicago Press)
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Michael E. Moritz College of Law

detail.title: BOOK REVIEW of Extralegal Governance: The Social Order of Illegal Markets in China, by Peng Wang and Wanlin Lin (Cambridge University Press, 2025). Forthcoming in the China Journal (University of Chicago Press)

detail.abstract: This is a solicited book review of Extralegal Governance: The Social Order of Illegal Markets in China, by Peng Wang and Wanlin Lin (Cambridge University Press, 2025)

AI.tldr: 本文是对《法外治理：中国非法市场的社会秩序》一书的受邀书评，该书由Peng Wang和Wanlin Lin撰写，剑桥大学出版社2025年出版。
AI.research_question: 该书探讨中国非法市场（如街头黑市、赌博、走私等）中如何形成社会秩序，以及法外治理机制如何运作。
AI.motivation: 理解在缺乏正式法律保障的非法市场中，参与者如何通过非正式规则和治理机制维持秩序，填补非法市场研究的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法外治理理论、社会秩序理论、非法市场社会学
AI.method: 书评性质，基于对该书的文本分析、案例梳理与理论评述。
AI.findings: 该书揭示了中国非法市场中存在的独特非正式治理机制，包括私人执法、关系网络、中间人调解等，形成了"法外但有序"的社会秩序。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了非法市场治理的研究视角，提出"法外治理"这一概念框架，丰富了制度经济学与社会学关于非正式制度的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解非法市场的运作逻辑提供参考，有助于设计更有效的治理策略而非简单取缔。

title: Border Carbon Adjustments Revisited
affiliations: University of Oldenburg, University of Oldenburg, World Bank Group and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Border Carbon Adjustments Revisited

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: To address concerns about competitiveness and carbon leakage, countries with ambitious climate policies are increasingly looking to combine unilateral carbon pricing with border carbon adjustments (BCA). BCA aim to create a level playing field between domestically regulated energy-intensive and trade-exposed industries and their competitors abroad by imposing charges on the (unpriced) carbon embodied in imports and (potentially) rebating carbon costs on exports. At the same time, BCA are seen as measures that may have protectionist motivation and shift the burden of climate policy onto poorer developing economies that bear less historical responsibility for climate change, have limited financial and technological capacity for decarbonization, and may depend on CO₂-intensive exports. For an informed policy debate, understanding how BCA alter the economic burden of unilateral emissions pricing across all countries is essential. However, quantitative impact estimates derived from ex-ante simulation analyses vary considerably in the applied economic literature due to divergent assumptions on key drivers whose relative importance is difficult to distinguish from the outset. Based on controlled simulations with a large-scale computable general equilibrium model of global trade and carbon use, this paper provides a systematic sensitivity analysis of three fundamental dimensions that determine the impacts of BCA: (i) the policy design of BCA; (ii) the price responsiveness of supply and demand; and (iii) the input-output data characterizing initial heterogeneities of production, consumption, and trade patterns across countries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模可计算一般均衡模型的系统敏感性分析，揭示了边境碳调整（BCA）政策效果受政策设计、供需价格弹性及国家间投入产出异质性三个关键因素驱动，解释了现有文献估算结果差异巨大的原因。
AI.research_question: 边境碳调整（BCA）如何改变单边碳定价对各国经济负担的分配？哪些关键因素导致现有定量影响估算结果存在巨大差异？
AI.motivation: 各国在实施单边碳定价时面临竞争力和碳泄漏担忧，BCA被视为平衡国内外产业竞争环境的工具，但其可能具有保护主义动机并将负担转嫁至发展中国家。现有量化研究结果差异巨大，需厘清关键驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型、国际贸易理论、碳定价与边境碳调整理论
AI.method: 基于大规模CGE模型的全球贸易与碳使用系统敏感性分析，对三个核心维度进行受控模拟：BCA政策设计、供需价格响应弹性、国家间投入产出数据异质性。
AI.findings: BCA的经济影响高度依赖于政策设计细节（如覆盖范围、出口退税安排）、供给与需求的价格弹性以及各国在生产、消费和贸易模式上的初始异质性；这些因素的差异是文献中估算结果不一致的根本原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过系统性敏感性分析框架，厘清了BCA影响的关键驱动因素及其相对重要性，为理解单边碳定价与边境调整政策的跨国经济负担分配提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计BCA方案提供了量化依据，揭示了政策细节对分配效应的重要性，有助于评估BCA对发展中国家公平性的影响，并为全球气候治理中的政策协调提供参考。

title: Challenges in Implementing the EU CAP New Delivery Model -The Bulgarian Case
affiliations: Institute of Agricultural Economics and Institute of Agricultural Economics

detail.title: Challenges in Implementing the EU CAP New Delivery Model -The Bulgarian Case

declarations.funderStatement: This study is funded by the Bulgarian Science Fund, the project "Agricultural land, green transformation, energy transition, digital environment", Contract No КП-06-Н96/2 from 9.12.2025.

detail.abstract: The New Delivery Model of the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy for 2023-2027 introduces a major shift toward decentralized governance, granting Member States greater flexibility to meet shared socioeconomic and environmental targets through unified National Strategic Plans. Key features include integrated Pillar I and II interventions, result-oriented annual reporting, mandatory eco-schemes, and digitalized satellite monitoring. Despite high expectations, Bulgarian and international research on the practical implementation challenges of this model remains scarce due to data gaps, short execution experiences, and shifting political focus toward the EU Green Deal and regional geopolitical crises. This book chapter addresses this research gap by providing an initial assessment of the challenges surrounding the CAP New Delivery Model within the Bulgarian context. A three-stage qualitative methodology was employed: an autoethnographic summary of the authors' direct experience in developing Bulgaria's Strategic Plan and SWOT analysis; 15 face-to-face in-depth interviews conducted in 2025 with institutional managers, agrarian producers, and independent experts; and a subsequent 7-expert Focus Group in 2026. By analyzing preparation, implementation, and monitoring dynamics alongside future shifts toward a National and Regional Partnership Plan, this study outlines critical strategic directions to optimize public interventions and stakeholder coordination for the next programming period.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于保加利亚的实践经验，采用三阶段定性方法（自我民族志、15次深度访谈、7人焦点小组），评估了欧盟2023-2027年共同农业政策新交付模式在准备、实施和监测中的挑战，并提出优化公共干预和利益相关者协调的战略方向。
AI.research_question: 欧盟共同农业政策新交付模式在保加利亚背景下实施面临哪些挑战？如何为下一规划期优化公共干预和利益相关者协调？
AI.motivation: 欧盟CAP新交付模式向去中心化治理重大转型，赋予成员国更大灵活性，但实际实施挑战的研究仍十分匮乏。保加利亚乃至国际层面因数据缺口、执行经验短促、政治焦点转向欧盟绿色协议和地缘政治危机，相关研究几近空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化治理理论、结果导向评估框架、多层级治理与利益相关者协调理论
AI.method: 三阶段定性方法：1) 作者在制定保加利亚战略计划中的自我民族志总结与SWOT分析；2) 2025年对机构管理者、农业生产者、独立专家进行15次面对面深度访谈；3) 2026年由7位专家组成的焦点小组讨论。
AI.findings: 识别了新交付模式在准备、实施和监测各阶段的现实挑战；揭示了未来向国家及区域伙伴关系计划转型的关键节点；提出了优化公共干预和利益相关者协调的战略方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了CAP新交付模式在成员国层面实施挑战的研究空白，为去中心化农业治理理论提供了东欧新兴成员国的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保加利亚及类似成员国在下一规划期优化CAP实施策略、加强利益相关者协调、提升数字化监测效果提供了可操作的战略建议。

title: Nowcasting Low-Income Countries Through Global Linkages
affiliations: and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: Nowcasting Low-Income Countries Through Global Linkages

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Timely assessment of economic activity is crucial for effective policymaking at the national, regional, and global levels. However, many economies still do not publish GDP data at a quarterly basis, creating persistent information gaps. In 2025, 34% of economies publish only annual GDP statistics. This lack of higher-frequency and timely data is particularly restrictive for emerging market and developing economies, where economic volatility and spillover risks are often highest. The problem is more severe for historical data: only 42% of economies have quarterly GDP estimates for a period longer than 20 years. To address these gaps, this paper develops a model that estimates missing quarterly GDP series by leveraging global and regional economic interconnections. The method transforms sparse annual data into quarterly estimates by exploiting higher-frequency information from the rest of the world, enabling real-time policymaking in both data-scarce economies and in global-level discussions. Moreover, this method ensures internally consistent estimates of regional and global economic activity, allowing both top-down and bottom-up scenario analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个利用全球和区域经济互联性，将稀疏的年度GDP数据转化为季度估算值的模型，以填补许多经济体缺乏高频GDP数据的信息缺口，支持实时政策制定。
AI.research_question: 如何利用全球和区域经济互联性，将稀疏的年度GDP数据转化为可靠的季度估算序列？
AI.motivation: 截至2025年，34%的经济体仅发布年度GDP数据，42%的经济体没有超过20年的季度GDP估算，这种高频数据缺失严重制约了新兴市场和发展中经济体的实时政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球经济互联性，利用世界其他地区的高频信息来推断缺失的季度GDP序列。
AI.method: 开发了一个估算模型，将稀疏的年度数据转化为季度估算值，利用全球和区域经济互联性以及世界其他地区的高频信息。
AI.findings: 该方法能够有效填补缺失的季度GDP数据，并确保区域和全球经济活动估算的内部一致性，支持自上而下和自下而上的情景分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种利用跨经济体互联性进行数据同频转换的新方法，解决了数据稀缺经济体缺乏高频经济指标的方法论难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助数据稀缺经济体实现实时政策制定，并为全球层面的讨论提供一致的区域和全球经济活动估算，支持情景分析。

title: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of voluntary and involuntary excess liquidity on monetary policy effectiveness and inflation in Kazakhstan. Consistent with first-principles predictions, we find that voluntary liquidity held for precautionary motives is (i) negatively related to the opportunity cost of holding liquid assets and to the level of mandatory reserve requirements; (ii) positively related to average liquidity outflows, proxied by transactional demand for cash; and (iii) ambiguously affected by the magnitude and volatility of the business cycle. We further show that higher voluntary liquidity weakens monetary policy transmission and increases exchange rate pass-through to inflation. In contrast, involuntary liquidity hampers monetary policy effectiveness no matter its level and it increases average inflation primarily through its influence on the formation of inflation expectations. Overall, the results suggest that reforms aimed at reducing both forms of liquidity would enhance monetary policy effectiveness and, ceteris paribus, reduce inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了哈萨克斯坦自愿性和非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策有效性和通货膨胀的影响，发现两种流动性都会削弱货币政策传导并推高通胀，但作用机制不同。
AI.research_question: 自愿性和非自愿性超额流动性如何影响货币政策有效性和通货膨胀？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体常面临超额流动性问题，但其来源（自愿与非自愿）对货币政策的影响尚不清晰，特别是哈萨克斯坦这类资源型经济体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性流动性需求理论、货币政策传导机制、通胀预期形成理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用哈萨克斯坦数据进行计量回归。
AI.findings: 自愿性流动性：与持有成本、准备金要求负相关；与交易性现金需求正相关；受商业周期影响不确定。自愿性流动性削弱货币政策传导、增大汇率传导至通胀。非自愿性流动性：无论高低均削弱货币政策有效性，通过通胀预期推高平均通胀。两种流动性减少均有助于增强货币政策效果并降低通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了自愿性与非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策的不同影响机制，丰富了超额流动性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈萨克斯坦及类似新兴经济体设计减少超额流动性、提升货币政策有效性的改革方案提供实证依据。

title: Peer Pressure
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF),  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Peer Pressure

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper shows that sovereign bond spreads are shaped not only by absolute debt levels but also by a country’s relative debt position within its peer group. Using panel fixed effects for over 80 emerging and developing economies over 1993-2024, we find that relative debt—especially benchmarked by income and commodity status—has greater explanatory power for spreads than gross debt alone. A one–standard deviation increase in relative debt raises spreads by roughly 0.2–0.3 standard deviations, comparable in magnitude to global risk indicators. Similarly, a 10 percent increase in relative debt is associated with a 3.8 percent increase in sovereign spreads, all else equal. The effect of relative debt is state-dependent, being stronger in countries with better institutions, access to concessional lending, and during periods of low risk aversion and ample global liquidity. These results hold across alternative specifications, sample periods, methodologies, and controls, which underscores the comparative nature of investor assessments and the importance of benchmarking for fiscal policy, debt management, and international surveillance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现主权债券利差不仅受绝对债务水平影响，还受一国在其同行群体中的相对债务位置影响。相对债务（尤其是按收入和商品状态分组）比总债务更能解释利差变化，且该效应在制度质量高、获得优惠贷款机会多、全球风险偏好高时更强。
AI.research_question: 主权债券利差如何受到一国在其同行群体中相对债务水平的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注绝对债务水平对主权利差的影响，但投资者在评估主权风险时往往会进行横向比较。作者试图揭示相对债务位置这一被忽视但重要的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者比较评估行为理论，结合主权风险定价模型，强调同行群体基准（peer benchmarking）在债券定价中的作用。
AI.method: 面板固定效应模型，覆盖1993-2024年80多个新兴和发展中经济体。使用收入和商品状态作为同行分组基准，并考察状态依赖性（institutions、concessional lending、global risk aversion等调节效应）。
AI.findings: 相对债务（按收入和商品地位分组）比总债务对利差的解释力更强；相对债务一个标准差上升使利差提高0.2-0.3个标准差；相对债务每增加10%，利差上升3.8%；该效应在制度质量高、优惠贷款可获得、全球风险规避低时更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将比较视角引入主权债务定价理论，证明了同行基准（peer benchmarking）是影响主权利差的重要机制，丰富了主权风险定价的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国财政政策和债务管理提供基准参照依据；为国际监督机构（如IMF）评估主权风险提供新的分析维度；提示政策制定者关注同行群体中的相对债务位置。

title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging
affiliations: Joint Vienna Institute and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Fiscal policy has re-emerged as a central tool of macroeconomic stabilization, yet the way governments communicate fiscal choices remains poorly understood. This paper provides the first systematic analysis of fiscal communication across the G7 from 2000–2024. Using a new dataset of budget documents, ministerial speeches, and press communiqués, we examine the clarity, thematic content, and rhetorical tone of official fiscal statements through computational text-analysis methods. We uncover a structured but fragmented communication architecture. Technical documents emphasize sustainability and constraints; speeches underscore growth, fairness, and investment; and press releases distill policy packages into succinct signals. Despite rising expectations of transparency, fiscal language remains complex and often optimistically framed. These patterns reflect institutional design, political incentives, and macroeconomic conditions. Our findings highlight fiscal communication as an underappreciated dimension of economic governance, one that shapes expectations, conditions credibility, and warrants deeper integration into fiscal policy analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了2000–2024年G7国家的财政沟通实践，利用预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报等新数据集，通过计算文本分析方法揭示财政沟通的清晰度、主题内容和修辞风格，发现其呈现结构化但碎片化的特征，并指出财政沟通是影响预期和可信度的重要但被低估的经济治理维度。
AI.research_question: G7国家如何通过官方财政声明进行沟通？其清晰度、主题内容和修辞风格呈现何种模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管财政政策重新成为宏观经济稳定的核心工具，但政府如何沟通财政选择仍缺乏系统理解。本研究填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政沟通作为经济治理维度；预期管理理论；制度设计与政治激励对沟通的影响。
AI.method: 构建2000–2024年G7国家预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报的新数据集，采用计算文本分析方法（包括清晰度、主题内容和修辞风格分析）。
AI.findings: 1. 财政沟通呈现结构化但碎片化的架构；2. 技术文件强调可持续性与约束，演讲突出增长、公平和投资，新闻公报则提炼政策包为简洁信号；3. 尽管透明度期望上升，财政语言仍复杂且倾向于乐观框架；4. 这些模式受制度设计、政治激励和宏观经济条件影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政沟通系统性地纳入经济治理分析，揭示其作为塑造预期和条件可信度的关键维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公众理解财政沟通的模式与影响提供实证依据，建议将财政沟通更深入地整合到财政政策分析中。

title: The Application of the Existing Intellectual Property Regime in the Metaverse: The United Kingdom as a Case Study

detail.title: The Application of the Existing Intellectual Property Regime in the Metaverse: The United Kingdom as a Case Study
detail.abstract:
The 21st-century innovations have presented one challenge to law everywhere in the world - the catch-up challenge. As expected, regulations ought not to stifle innovation. From the thoughts of Neal Stephenson to the declaration of Meta (formerly Facebook), we are now

witnessing a technological evolution that requires a holistic approach from Intellectual Property (IP) practitioners across the globe. The IP community is already thinking of how IP will find relevance in the metaverse. To critically contribute to this discussion, this

dissertation traces the origins of the metaverse to its present-day status. It considers its entire setup and how the law could regulate the metaverse. Agreed that there is no metaverse-specific regulation yet both at the international and national level, we can adapt the current IP laws in the United Kingdom to regulate the metaverse components worthy of IP protection.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在元宇宙技术快速发展的背景下，知识产权法如何应对挑战。作者认为，尽管目前尚无针对元宇宙的专门法规，但可以利用英国现有的知识产权法律来保护元宇宙中值得IP保护的要素。
AI.research_question: 现有的知识产权法律体系能否以及如何适应并监管元宇宙中的创新成果？
AI.motivation: 21世纪的技术创新对全球法律体系提出了"追赶挑战"，元宇宙的兴起要求知识产权从业者思考IP如何在这一新领域保持相关性，而目前尚无专门的元宇宙法规。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法理论、技术规制理论、法律适应性与创新规制平衡理论。
AI.method: 文献追溯法（追溯元宇宙的起源至现状）、比较分析法（考察国际与国内层面的法律现状）、规范分析法（分析英国现有IP法律对元宇宙的适用性）。
AI.findings: 元宇宙尚未有专门的国际或国家层面的法规；英国现有的知识产权法律可以经过适应性解释，用于监管元宇宙中值得IP保护的相关要素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为知识产权法在数字虚拟空间（元宇宙）中的适用性提供了理论拓展，论证了现有法律框架通过解释可以应对新兴技术挑战，丰富了法律适应性的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IP从业者和政策制定者提供了具体路径——在缺乏专门立法的情况下，如何利用英国现行IP法律对元宇宙中的创新成果进行保护，为其他国家完善元宇宙知识产权治理提供了参考。

title: An Analytical Study Of The 8th Pay Commission And Its Consequences For Public Sector Employees And Pensioners

detail.title: An Analytical Study Of The 8th Pay Commission And Its Consequences For Public Sector Employees And Pensioners
detail.abstract: Central government employees and pensioners in India are no strangers to the expectations that surround a Pay Commission. But the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC) has created a level of attention like no other in recent memory, and with reason to. This is one of the largest pay revision exercises in the country's administrative history, with more than 50 lakh serving employees and about 69 lakh pensioners awaiting their benefits 1. This is a detailed breakdown of everything that has already occurred, how the numbers may appear, and what you can reasonably expect over the coming months. A BRIEF HISTORY: WHY PAY COMMISSIONS MATTER In India, the Pay Commission system refers to a periodic review of the salaries, allowances, and pension schemes of employees of the central government. Each Pay Commission, constituted about once every ten years, is an exhaustive review of the emoluments structure, with its recommendations accepted, revised, or amended by the government before implementation. 2 The 7 th Pay Commission, implemented in January 2016, changed the pay landscape for government employees. It introduced a pay matrix, changed the fitment factor to 2.57, and increased the minimum basic pay from 7,000 per month to 18,000 per month. A decade later, when purchasing power in real terms has been eroded by inflation, housing prices have soared, and healthcare costs have also increased dramatically, a new revision is much needed.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了印度第八届中央薪酬委员会的背景、历史意义及预期影响，概述了其覆盖范围（约500万在职雇员和690万养老金领取者），并回顾了第七届薪酬委员会的关键改革（如薪酬矩阵、适配因子2.57、最低基本工资从7000卢比提高到18000卢比），指出在通胀、房价和医疗成本上涨的背景下，新一轮薪酬修订势在必行。
AI.research_question: 印度第八届中央薪酬委员会的构成背景、历史脉络、预期影响及其在公务员薪酬制度改革中的意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 在通胀侵蚀购买力、房价和医疗成本大幅上涨的背景下，印度中央政府的在职雇员和养老金领取者迫切需要新一轮薪酬修订，以恢复其实际收入水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 薪酬委员会制度（周期性薪酬审查机制）、购买力平价理论、通货膨胀对实际工资的影响、公务员薪酬公平性理论。
AI.method: 历史回顾与文献分析，基于前几届薪酬委员会（特别是第七届）的实施数据与政策演变，结合当前经济指标（通胀率、房价指数、医疗成本）进行需求评估。
AI.findings: 第八届薪酬委员会是印度行政史上规模最大的薪酬修订工作之一，覆盖约500万在职雇员和690万养老金领取者；第七届薪酬委员会（2016年实施）将最低基本工资从7000卢比/月提升至18000卢比/月，但十年后购买力已被通胀侵蚀，房价和医疗成本大幅上升，新一轮修订势在必行。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为周期性公共部门薪酬审查机制提供了印度语境下的实证案例，丰富了关于公务员薪酬制度改革、通胀对实际收入影响的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度中央政府雇员、养老金领取者及政策制定者提供了第八届薪酬委员会的背景解读、历史对比和预期展望，有助于公众理解薪酬修订的必要性和可能走向。

title: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting

detail.title: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Making informed policy decisions is contingent upon the availability of reliable and timely data. The use of non-traditional data has been shown to be a powerful tool for enabling policymakers to conduct robust nowcasting—the practice of estimating the current period’s economic indicator(s), ahead of official releases, using a wide range of macroeconomic and high-frequency data. This paper showcases how different types of non-traditional data, such as indices extracted from satellite imagery, Google Trends, and flight tracking information, can be leveraged to complement official statistics and monitor economic activity, and how these timely signals can be incorporated into nowcasting models to provide early estimates of key macroeconomic variables in Morocco. The approach is applied to agricultural gross value added, tourism revenues, and the unemployment rate. The results demonstrate that non-traditional data substantially improves nowcasting models by enhancing predictive accuracy and enabling the rapid generation of nowcast estimates prior to the release of official data.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何利用卫星图像、谷歌趋势和航班追踪等非传统数据，结合官方统计数据进行即时预测（nowcasting），以摩洛哥农业增加值、旅游收入和失业率为例，验证了非传统数据能显著提升预测精度并提前生成经济指标估计。
AI.research_question: 非传统数据（如卫星图像、谷歌趋势、航班追踪信息）如何被整合到即时预测模型中，以提前且准确地估计摩洛哥的关键宏观经济变量？
AI.motivation: 政策决策依赖可靠且及时的数据，但官方数据发布存在时滞。非传统数据有望填补这一空白，但如何系统性地将其纳入即时预测模型并评估其效果仍需实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 即时预测（nowcasting）理论，强调利用高频非传统数据补充低频官方统计数据，通过计量经济模型捕捉当前经济状况的实时信号。
AI.method: 采用卫星图像、谷歌趋势、航班追踪等非传统数据源，构建即时预测模型，应用于摩洛哥的农业增加值、旅游收入和失业率三个指标，并与仅使用传统数据的基准模型进行对比。
AI.findings: 非传统数据显著提升了即时预测模型的预测精度，能够在官方数据发布前快速生成可靠的即时预测估计值。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了非传统数据在发展中国家（摩洛哥）即时预测中的有效性，拓展了即时预测理论的应用场景和数据源范畴。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种可操作的方法，利用非传统数据提前监测经济动态，支持更及时的政策决策，尤其适用于官方统计数据发布滞后的环境。

title: Community-based Preventive Care and Inpatient Resource Use Among Older Adults in China: A Province-wide Linked-record Cohort Study
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College (CAMS & PUMC), Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College (CAMS & PUMC), Zhengzhou University - Fuwai Central China Cardiovascular Hospital, Zhengzhou University - Fuwai Central China Cardiovascular Hospital, Zhengzhou University - Fuwai Central China Cardiovascular Hospital, Health Commission of Henan Province, Health Commission of Henan Province, Health Commission of Henan Province, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University - Fuwai Central China Cardiovascular Hospital and Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College (CAMS & PUMC)

detail.title: Community-based Preventive Care and Inpatient Resource Use Among Older Adults in China: A Province-wide Linked-record Cohort Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Research, New Technology and New Service Ethics Committee of Fuwai Central China Cardiovascular Hospital (approval number [2025] Ethics Review No. 25); informed consent was waived because the analysis used de-identified administrative records.
declarations.funderStatement: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences (CAMS) Innovation Fund for Medical Sciences (2021-I2M-1-046)

detail.abstract:
Background: Health systems facing population ageing need scalable ways to maintain preventive contact with older adults who have multimorbidity while hospital capacity remains under pressure. It is not well established whether sustained community-based preventive contact before admission is associated with lower inpatient resource intensity among older adults who are eventually admitted. We examined this question in a province-wide linked-record cohort from Henan, China, using the National Essential Public Health Services (NEPHS) elderly health-management programme as a routine community-based preventive-care exposure.

Methods: We did a retrospective linked-record cohort study using public-hospital inpatient discharge records, the NEPHS elderly health-management registry, and patient identifier files from Henan Province between 2019 and 2024. The primary exposure was NEPHS enrolment before the index admission. The primary outcomes were total inpatient cost and length of stay. We estimated a primary population-level adjusted contrast in the full complete-covariate cohort, design-balanced contrasts using inverse-probability-of-treatment weighting (IPTW), overlap weighting, and propensity-score matching, and a within-person fixed-effects contrast among enrolment switchers. The Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) was examined as a candidate clinical pathway, including attenuation and mediation analyses.

Findings: The primary complete-covariate cohort included 19,425,809 admissions among 5,938,289 patients aged 65 years or older. In the primary adjusted model, NEPHS enrolment before admission was associated with an approximately 9·9% lower total inpatient cost and a 0·679-day shorter length of stay. Estimates from IPTW, overlap weighting, and propensity-score matching were broadly consistent in direction and magnitude. Within-person fixed-effects estimates among switchers were smaller, suggesting that residual between-person selection contributed to the population-level association. Attenuation and mediation analyses were consistent with CCI contributing to part of the observed association. Associations were stronger for admissions among the oldest adults, those with recorded comorbidity, and some insurance-defined groups, especially admissions covered by the New Rural Cooperative Medical Scheme (NRCMS).

Interpretation: Prior NEPHS enrolment was associated with lower per-admission inpatient cost and shorter length of stay among older adults admitted to public hospitals in Henan. These findings are consistent with a population-level preventive-care interpretation in which sustained community-based preventive contact may be most relevant for people with greater clinical need and for some insurance-defined groups. Causal claims, conclusions about aggregate expenditure, and confirmation of mediation pathways require prospective or quasi-experimental studies with richer clinical and quality-of-care outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用河南省2019-2024年近600万65岁以上老年人的关联记录数据，发现入院前参与国家基本公共卫生服务（NEPHS）老年人健康管理项目的居民，其住院总费用降低约9.9%，住院时间缩短0.679天。这一关联在高龄、有合并症及新农合参保群体中更为显著，提示社区预防性接触可能有助于降低住院资源消耗。
AI.research_question: 在老年多病共存且医院容量持续承压的背景下，入院前持续的社区预防性接触（以NEPHS老年人健康管理项目为代表）是否与最终住院的老年患者的住院资源强度（住院总费用和住院时长）降低相关？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化背景下，卫生系统需要可扩展的方式来维持对多病共存老年人的预防性接触，但入院前社区预防性接触与住院资源强度之间的关系尚未明确。本研究旨在利用大规模真实世界数据填补这一证据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以社区预防保健接触为核心概念，基于"预防性保健-疾病管理-住院资源利用"的逻辑链条，将Charlson合并症指数（CCI）作为候选临床路径，通过衰减分析和中介分析检验其机制。
AI.method: 回顾性关联记录队列研究，数据来源为河南省2019-2024年公立医院住院记录、NEPHS老年人健康管理登记册和患者标识文件。主要暴露指标为入院前NEPHS登记状态。采用完全协变量调整模型、逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）、重叠加权、倾向性评分匹配、以及登记状态转换者内部的固定效应模型等多种方法估计关联效应，并进行衰减分析和中介分析。
AI.findings: 完全协变量队列包含19,425,809次入院（5,938,289名65岁以上患者）。入院前NEPHS登记与住院总费用降低约9.9%、住院时长缩短0.679天相关。IPTW、重叠加权和倾向性评分匹配结果在方向和幅度上基本一致。转换者内部固定效应估计值较小，提示残差的个体间选择对群体层面的关联有贡献。CCI部分中介了所观察到的关联。该关联在高龄、有合并症记录及新农合参保群体中更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"社区预防性保健可降低住院资源利用"提供了来自大规模真实世界人群的证据支持；通过多种因果推断方法（IPTW、重叠加权、PSM、固定效应）和中介分析，系统检验了关联的稳健性和潜在机制路径（CCI的部分中介作用），丰富了预防保健经济学和老年健康服务研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了中国大规模基本公共卫生服务项目（NEPHS）对住院资源影响的量化证据；提示社区预防性保健可能对临床需求更大的人群（高龄、合并症患者）和特定医保群体（新农合）有更强的资源节约效应；为完善老年人健康管理服务、优化资源配置提供了实证依据。

title: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business, Yale SOM and

detail.title: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
detail.abstract: We construct a novel stock-level measure of volatility disagreement as the cross-sectional dispersion of realized variance forecasts built from heterogeneous information sets and machine learning models. Sorting single-name delta-hedged straddles on this measure yields a long-short return of-5.14% per month, robust to known option return predictors and not subsumed by disagreement about first moments or the variance risk premium. A one-standarddeviation increase in volatility disagreement is associated with a 30% rise in option position opening. The cross-sectional patterns of our disagreement measure align with recent theoretical advances of beliefs and pricing of variance claims. Evidence on attention, ownership, and arbitrage costs is more consistent with mispricing than risk compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于机器学习模型和异质信息集的股票层面波动率分歧度量，发现该度量能显著预测期权收益，且与已知因子无关，表明波动率分歧是期权定价的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 波动率分歧如何影响期权市场定价和投资者行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注一阶矩（收益）的分歧，但二阶矩（波动率）的分歧对期权定价至关重要，且缺乏有效的股票层面度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质信息集和机器学习的波动率分歧度量；期权定价理论；信念分歧与方差索取权定价理论。
AI.method: 利用机器学习模型和异质信息集构建波动率分歧度量（cross-sectional dispersion of realized variance forecasts），进行多空组合排序分析、回归分析和横截面检验。
AI.findings: 波动率分歧产生的多空组合月收益为-5.14%，该效应不被已知期权收益预测因子、一阶矩分歧或方差风险溢价所解释；波动率分歧增加一个标准差与期权头寸开仓量上升30%相关；证据支持错误定价而非风险补偿解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信念分歧与方差索取权定价理论提供了实证支持；建立了波动率分歧作为期权市场重要定价因子的理论地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了新的期权收益预测指标和交易策略；揭示了波动率分歧对期权市场流动性和交易行为的实际影响。

title: Mapping Causal Machine Learning in Energy Finance Domain
affiliations: School of Business and Economics, Humboldt-University of Berlin, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Bucharest University of Economic Studies and Berlin Institute of Health - Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin

detail.title: Mapping Causal Machine Learning in Energy Finance Domain

declarations.funderStatement: This paper is supported through the European Cooperation in Science & Technology COST Action grant CA19130 - Fintech and Artificial Intelligence in Finance - Towards a transparent financial industry; the project “IDA Institute of Digital Assets'', CF166/15.11.2022, contract number CN760046/ 23.05.2023; the project „AI for Energy Finance (AI4EFin)'', CF162/15.11.2022, contract number CN760048/23.05.2023, financed under the Romania’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan, Apel nr. PNRR-III-C9-2022-I8; and the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions under the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation program for the Industrial Doctoral Network on Digital Finance, acronym DIGITAL, Project No. 101119635. This paper was co-financed by the Bucharest University of Economic Studies (ASE) during the PhD program.

detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of machine learning techniques in financial and energy market research has coincided with a renewed emphasis on causal inference frameworks that deliver structurally interpretable and policy-relevant insights. Although these domains have developed extensively in parallel, their systematic integration remains limited and insufficiently mapped. This paper surveys the literature on the intersection of causal inference, energy finance, and machine learning. First, we conduct a bibliometric analysis using a systematic search strategy organized into three conceptual blocks: causal inference, energy finance, and machine learning. Second, we identify and synthesize the principal methodological commonalities across the selected studies. We classify contributions by their empirical settings and data structures, highlighting how causality is operationalized in data-driven energy finance applications. Third, we provide an indepth methodological overview of the main approaches employed in this literature.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了因果推断、能源金融与机器学习三个领域的交叉文献，通过文献计量分析和方法论梳理，揭示了数据驱动的能源金融研究中因果性的操作化方式。
AI.research_question: 因果推断、能源金融与机器学习这三个领域如何实现系统性的整合，以及在数据驱动的能源金融应用中因果性是如何被操作化的。
AI.motivation: 尽管机器学习技术在金融和能源市场研究中迅速扩散，且因果推断框架受到重视，但这两个领域的系统整合仍然有限且缺乏充分的梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果推断框架、机器学习方法、能源金融理论
AI.method: 系统性文献综述、文献计量分析、方法论分类与综合
AI.findings: 识别了三个概念块（因果推断、能源金融、机器学习）的文献交集，分类了基于不同实证情境和数据结构的贡献，提供了主要方法论方法的深入概述。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了因果推断、能源金融与机器学习三个领域的交叉文献，为数据驱动的能源金融研究提供了因果性操作化的分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源金融领域的研究者和实践者提供了清晰的方法论地图，帮助理解如何在数据驱动的应用中实施因果推断。

title: Assessing Climate-Related Health Risks in Morocco: Towards an Econometric Data-Driven Early Warning System
affiliations: Ibn Tofail University and Ibn Tofail University

detail.title: Assessing Climate-Related Health Risks in Morocco: Towards an Econometric Data-Driven Early Warning System
detail.abstract: This article assesses climate-related health risks in Morocco by proposing an econometric data-driven early warning system. Using a Vector Autoregression (VAR) model applied to annual data from 2000 to 2020, we analyze the dynamic interactions between life expectancy (LE), CO₂ emissions, the overall health budget (BGS), the number of inhabitants per physician (NHM), and the number of inhabitants per healthcare facility (NHE). Stationarity tests confirm the stability of the series in logarithmic differences, and model diagnostics validate its specification.The results show that LE in Morocco exhibits high inertia, with more than 94% of its variance explained by its own past shocks. CO₂ emissions, although positively correlated with LE in descriptive analyses, account for only about 1.35% of the variance in LE over a ten-year horizon, with a delayed effect. The health budget (BGS) contributes moderately (approximately 2%), confirming the importance of public health investments. Impulse response functions reveal that CO₂ shocks do not have a significant immediate impact on LE, suggesting a relative resilience of Morocco's health system to climate variability during the study period, possibly mitigated by the country's low emission levels and energy transition policies.This work provides an operational econometric framework for monitoring the impact of climate and health variables. It highlights the predominance of structural health determinants and argues for the targeted integration of climate indicators into epidemiological surveillance systems, enabling proactive health policy adapted to environmental challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于VAR模型的计量经济学预警系统，分析摩洛哥2000-2020年气候相关健康风险。研究发现预期寿命具有高度惯性（94%以上由自身解释），CO₂排放仅解释约1.35%的方差，卫生预算贡献约2%，表明摩洛哥卫生系统对气候波动具有相对韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个数据驱动的早期预警系统，以评估摩洛哥气候变化相关的健康风险？具体而言，CO₂排放、卫生预算、医疗资源等变量如何动态影响预期寿命？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对公共健康构成日益严重的威胁，但关于发展中国家（尤其是北非地区）气候与健康之间动态关系的计量经济学证据有限。摩洛哥作为气候脆弱国家，需要建立可操作的监测框架以支持适应性卫生政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量自回归（VAR）模型；变量交互动态理论；健康决定因素理论（包括环境因素、卫生投入、医疗资源可及性等结构性因素）。
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年年度数据，构建包含预期寿命（LE）、CO₂排放、卫生总预算（BGS）、每名医生对应的居民数（NHM）、每所医疗机构对应的居民数（NHE）的五变量VAR模型。进行平稳性检验（对数差分后序列稳定）、模型诊断、方差分解和脉冲响应函数分析。
AI.findings: 1）摩洛哥预期寿命具有高度惯性，超过94%的方差由其自身过去冲击解释；2）CO₂排放虽在描述性分析中与预期寿命正相关，但在十年期方差分解中仅贡献约1.35%，且影响具有滞后性；3）卫生预算贡献约2%，证实公共健康投资的重要性；4）脉冲响应函数显示CO₂冲击对预期寿命无显著即时影响，表明研究期间摩洛哥卫生系统对气候波动具有相对韧性，可能受益于低排放水平和能源转型政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候健康风险研究提供了一个可操作的计量经济学框架，将VAR模型应用于发展中国家的气候-健康动态分析；揭示了结构性健康决定因素（而非短期环境冲击）在预期寿命变化中的主导作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将气候指标有针对性地整合到流行病学监测系统中，以便制定适应环境挑战的主动卫生政策；为摩洛哥及其他类似发展中国家提供了基于数据的政策制定工具，帮助在卫生预算和气候适应之间进行资源优化配置。

title: Bivariate sudden stop analysis of equity and bond fund flows to emerging markets using isolation forest
affiliations: and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Bivariate sudden stop analysis of equity and bond fund flows to emerging markets using isolation forest

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper applies machine learning methods and anomaly detection to sudden stop analysis of portfolio flows. Using the isolation forest methodology, univariate as well as bivariate sudden stops of equity and bond fund flows to emerging markets are generated. An anomaly score and an anomaly classification are provided. The results point to an increase in anomalous portfolio flows to emerging markets in recent years. In addition, the isolation forest methodology appears to yield better results than the traditional approach to sudden stop analysis in classifying anomalies connected with the recent capital flow volatility related to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic as well as the interest rate reversal in advanced economies in recent years. The bivariate approach to anomaly detection is better able to identify anomalous episodes of financial stress, where both equity and bond markets are simultaneously affected. Most of the classified anomalies are related to fund flow stops (i.e. simultaneous stops to both equity and bond flows) or surges (i.e. surges in both equity and bond flows). In general, univariate and bivariate anomaly detection using machine learning techniques can play an important part and lead to a better understanding of sudden stops and surges.

AI.tldr: 本文运用机器学习方法（孤立森林）和异常检测技术分析新兴市场组合资本流动的突然停止问题，发现近年来异常流动增加，且该方法在识别COVID-19和发达经济体利率反转相关的资本流动波动方面优于传统方法。双变量方法能更好识别股票和债券市场同时受影响的金融压力事件。
AI.research_question: 如何运用机器学习和异常检测方法更好地识别和分析新兴市场组合资本流动（股票和债券基金）的突然停止与激增现象？
AI.motivation: 传统突然停止分析方法在识别近年资本流动波动（如COVID-19疫情、发达经济体利率反转）方面存在局限，需要更有效的方法来识别和理解新兴市场的异常资本流动事件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 孤立森林（Isolation Forest）异常检测方法；单变量与双变量突然停止分析框架。
AI.method: 采用孤立森林机器学习方法，对新兴市场的股票和债券基金流进行单变量和双变量异常检测，生成异常分数和异常分类，并与传统方法进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. 近年来新兴市场异常组合资本流动增加；2. 孤立森林方法在识别COVID-19和利率反转相关异常方面优于传统方法；3. 双变量方法能更好识别股票和债券市场同时受影响的金融压力事件；4. 大多数分类异常与流动停止或激增相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习异常检测方法（孤立森林）引入突然停止分析领域，提出单变量和双变量相结合的分析框架，拓展了资本流动异常识别的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供更准确的资本流动异常识别工具，有助于提前预警新兴市场的金融压力事件，特别是在全球冲击（如疫情、利率变化）背景下。

title: A Multidimensional Statistical Approach to Assessing the Effectiveness of Targeting Mechanisms for Household Vulnerability to Poverty in Tanzania: Evidence from the 2022 Tanzania Demographic and Health Survey (TDHS)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Multidimensional Statistical Approach to Assessing the Effectiveness of Targeting Mechanisms for Household Vulnerability to Poverty in Tanzania: Evidence from the 2022 Tanzania Demographic and Health Survey (TDHS)
detail.abstract: The study employed a multidimensional statistical approach to assess the effectiveness of targeting mechanisms for household vulnerability to poverty in Tanzania. Currently, Tanzania employs a traditional hybrid (three-stage) targeting system that integrates community-based targeting, proxy means testing, and geographic testing to identify truly poor and vulnerable households. The study found that household vulnerability is primarily influenced by physical living conditions and asset ownership, with associated indicators such as housing floor quality, wall material quality, access to electricity, and durable asset ownership serving as the most significant predictors. Using model evaluation metrics such as accuracy, F1-score, inclusion, and exclusion errors, a comparative analysis of predictive models (Random Forest, Proxy Means Testing, Extreme Gradient Boosting) was also conducted; the Random Forest model outperformed Proxy Means Testing (representing hybrid targeting system) and Extreme Gradient Boosting models by achieving the highest F1-score and the lowest exclusion error, making it the most efficient tool for identifying poor and vulnerable households that genuinely meet eligibility criteria for social protection programs. Moreover, Moran’s I scatterplot showed that vulnerability in Tanzania is not randomly distributed or dispersed, but geographically clustered, and identified the Katavi region as a statistically significant hotspot for targeted policy interventions using the local indicators of spatial association (LISA) map. The study, then, concludes that incorporating modern machine learning models, such as Random Forest with spatial mapping, for significant clustering is crucial to enhancing the accuracy, equity, and efficiency of existing social protection programs in identifying truly vulnerable households in Tanzania.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用多维统计方法评估坦桑尼亚贫困脆弱性家庭瞄准机制的有效性，发现随机森林模型结合空间聚类分析优于传统混合瞄准系统，能更精准识别真正需要社会保护的家庭。
AI.research_question: 坦桑尼亚现有的传统混合（三阶段）瞄准机制在识别贫困脆弱性家庭方面的有效性如何？现代机器学习模型能否提升这一机制的精确度、公平性和效率？
AI.motivation: 坦桑尼亚目前采用的传统混合瞄准系统（社区瞄准+代理家计测试+地理测试）可能存在识别误差，导致真正脆弱的家庭被遗漏或非贫困家庭被错误纳入，影响社会保护资源的精准配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭脆弱性理论、贫困瞄准机制理论、空间依赖理论
AI.method: 多维统计方法；比较分析随机森林、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和代理家计测试（PMT）三种预测模型；利用Moran's I和LISA地图进行空间自相关分析。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭脆弱性主要受物质生活条件和资产所有权影响，如住房地板质量、墙体材料质量、通电情况和耐用品所有权是最显著的预测指标。2. 随机森林模型在F1分数和排除错误方面优于PMT和XGBoost。3. 坦桑尼亚的脆弱性呈空间聚类分布，Katavi地区是统计上显著的热点区域。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了机器学习模型（特别是随机森林）在贫困脆弱性识别中的理论优势，拓展了空间统计方法在社会保护瞄准机制中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议坦桑尼亚将随机森林模型与空间映射结合，提升现有社会保护项目的瞄准精度、公平性和效率；识别出Katavi地区作为政策干预的重点区域。

title: CLIMATE MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES AND THEIR IMPACT ON SMALLHOLDER POULTRY SUSTAINABILITY AND POVERTY REDUCTION IN NIGERIA
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Lagos State University of Science and Technology

detail.title: CLIMATE MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES AND THEIR IMPACT ON SMALLHOLDER POULTRY SUSTAINABILITY AND POVERTY REDUCTION IN NIGERIA
detail.abstract: Purpose: Climate change poses a severe threat to Nigerian smallholder poultry production. This situation negatively affects poultry productivity, aggravates food insecurity, and amplifies,poverty vulnerability. This research evaluates the adaptation methods used by smallholder poultry farmers in Nigeria and their effectiveness in improving livelihoods.,Methodology: Using an exploratory research design, we employed a multistage sampling technique to select 360 farmers from the study area.,Findings: Cooperative membership and extension services played a crucial role in enabling the adoption of climate management strategies. Poultry farmers producing exclusively chicken meat had lower likelihoods of utilising extension services (0.224) and of being cooperative members (0.296) in adopting climate strategies, compared to those producing both live birds and eggs. 82% of poultry meat farmers were aware of climate management strategies. 88% of farmers have adopted climate management strategies, including technological innovations (such as water management), veterinary interventions (like vitamins and medicine), and traditional knowledge systems. These management strategies significantly reduced poverty among smallholder poultry farmers.,Practical implication: The study thus proposes establishing a Smallholder Poultry Innovation Platform to foster collaboration, accelerate the adoption of innovations, and promote sustainable, climate-resilient poultry production in Nigeria. The recommendation is to distribute climate management strategies to farmers through public awareness campaigns by established networks including extension services, input suppliers, and cooperatives. The study aligns with key global sustainable development goals focused on poverty reduction (SDG 1), hunger elimination (SDG 2), and climate action (SDG 13).

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了尼日利亚小规模家禽养殖户的气候适应策略及其对生计改善的效果，发现合作社和推广服务对采纳气候管理策略至关重要，这些策略显著降低了农户贫困水平。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚小规模家禽养殖户采用哪些适应气候变化的方法，以及这些方法在改善生计方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对尼日利亚小规模家禽养殖构成严重威胁，导致家禽生产力下降、粮食不安全加剧和贫困脆弱性增加，亟需评估现有的适应策略及其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化适应理论、小农户生计框架、技术采纳与扩散理论、合作社与推广服务的作用机制
AI.method: 采用探索性研究设计，通过多阶段抽样技术从研究区域选取360名养殖户进行调研分析。
AI.findings: 合作社成员身份和推广服务对采纳气候管理策略至关重要；纯肉鸡养殖户使用推广服务和加入合作社的可能性低于同时生产活禽和蛋类的养殖户；82%的肉鸡养殖户知晓气候管理策略；88%的养殖户已采纳包括技术创新、兽医干预和传统知识系统在内的气候管理策略；这些策略显著降低了小规模养殖户的贫困水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型家禽生产模式（纯肉鸡 vs. 活禽和蛋类混合生产）在采纳气候适应策略上的差异化机制，丰富了小农户气候变化适应行为的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立小规模家禽创新平台促进协作；建议通过推广服务、投入品供应商和合作社等网络开展公共宣传运动，向农户传播气候管理策略；研究结果与联合国可持续发展目标1（消除贫困）、目标2（消除饥饿）和目标13（气候行动）相契合。

title: Temporal misalignment of income and nutrition in cash-crop food systems of Sub-Saharan Africa: Rethinking food security policy
affiliations: International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI), Wollo University and Ethiopian Public Health Institute

detail.title: Temporal misalignment of income and nutrition in cash-crop food systems of Sub-Saharan Africa: Rethinking food security policy
detail.abstract: Summary In many cash-crop economies across Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), increased agricultural income does not always translate into improved food security or nutrition. While the income-nutrition gap is a long-standing challenge, this paper identifies why modern climate volatility and the 'lumpiness' of the 2026 global commodity market have created a 'new seasonality' that requires shifting from yield-based metrics to temporally aligned nutritional benchmarks. This paper argues that this disconnect reflects a failure of temporal alignment within food systems, where the timing of income, food availability, and nutritional needs are poorly synchronized. Seasonal income concentration, limited capacity for consumption smoothing, and intra-household allocation dynamics interact to produce predictable cycles of vulnerability. These dynamics are further shaped by market seasonality, gender relations, and nutrition knowledge. Addressing food insecurity therefore requires moving beyond income-focused approaches toward strategies that improve how and when resources are converted into food and care. Strengthening financial practices, empowering women in decision-making, and aligning interventions with seasonal realities are critical for achieving sustained nutritional gains.

AI.tldr: 本文指出撒哈拉以南非洲现金作物经济中，农业收入增长未能有效转化为营养改善，根源在于收入、食物供应与营养需求之间存在"时间错配"。现代气候波动和全球大宗商品市场的"块状"特征加剧了这种错配，形成"新季节性"，需要从产量指标转向时间对齐的营养基准。
AI.research_question: 为什么撒哈拉以南非洲现金作物经济中，增加的农业收入未能有效改善粮食安全与营养状况？如何解决这一"收入-营养鸿沟"？
AI.motivation: 长期存在的"收入-营养鸿沟"在气候变化和2026年全球大宗商品市场新格局下变得更加严峻，传统以产量为核心的评估指标已不足以应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: "时间错配"理论（收入、食物供应与营养需求的时间同步性失败）；"新季节性"概念（气候波动与市场块状性共同作用）；消费平滑理论；家庭内部资源分配动态；市场季节性、性别关系与营养知识的交互作用。
AI.method: 理论论证与概念框架构建，整合农业经济学、营养学、性别研究等多学科视角。
AI.findings: 1) 季节性收入集中与有限的消费平滑能力相互叠加，形成可预测的脆弱性周期；2) 家庭内部资源分配动态（尤其是性别关系）加剧了时间错配；3) 市场季节性、性别关系和营养知识共同塑造了营养结果；4) 需要从收入导向转向时间对齐的资源转化策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"时间错配"作为理解收入-营养鸿沟的新理论框架；发展"新季节性"概念以解释现代气候与市场条件下的营养脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用时间对齐的营养基准替代传统产量指标；强调强化金融实践（如消费平滑工具）、赋权女性决策权、以及根据季节性现实调整干预措施的具体策略。

title: The Emissions Paradox of Green Hydrogen Quotas in Multi-Carrier Energy Hubs
affiliations: , Aalborg University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST) and Ewha Womans University

detail.title: The Emissions Paradox of Green Hydrogen Quotas in Multi-Carrier Energy Hubs
detail.abstract: Green hydrogen quota policies are based on the assumption that mandating hydrogen production through renewable-energy-based electrolysis leads to a reduction in greenhouse-gas emissions. This study shows that, in integrated energy systems with shared renewable resources, this assumption can be violated and the quota can instead trigger a system-level CO2 paradox. The underlying mechanism, referred to here as renewable energy cannibalization, arises when the electrolyzer, under quota pressure, diverts clean electricity from other co-located uses and the resulting deficit is compensated through carbon-intensive electricity imports from the upstream grid. To quantify this effect, a multi-carrier energy hub with independent agents interconnected through electricity, heat, and hydrogen buses is designed, and its performance is evaluated within a centralized mixed-integer linear programming framework. The green hydrogen quota is modeled under both aggregate-matching and hourly-matching approaches, and its effect is examined across 99 combinations of quota level and renewable penetration. The results show that, under aggregate matching, renewable energy cannibalization can lead to a policy triple failure, simultaneously causing higher emissions and system cost together with a contraction of the hydrogen economy. Hourly matching shifts the paradox boundary by about 5 to 11 percentage points, but does not eliminate it. The results also show that the boundary between policy success and failure under the hydrogen quota follows an approximately linear relationship, and that a green hydrogen quota without proportionate expansion of renewable capacity can operate in reverse.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在共享可再生能源的一体化能源系统中，绿氢配额政策可能导致“可再生能能源蚕食”效应，即电解槽占用清洁电力后，系统需从电网进口高碳电力，反而增加整体碳排放，造成政策三重失败。
AI.research_question: 绿氢配额政策在共享可再生能源的一体化能源系统中，是否会导致系统层面的CO2悖论（即排放不降反升）？其背后的机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 绿氢配额政策假设通过可再生能源电解制氢能减少温室气体排放，但在集成能源系统中，该假设可能不成立。本研究旨在揭示这一潜在反直觉效应及其政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可再生能能源蚕食（Renewable Energy Cannibalization）、CO2悖论、政策三重失败（同时导致更高排放、更高系统成本及氢经济萎缩）
AI.method: 构建多载体能源枢纽模型（含电力、热力、氢气），采用集中式混合整数线性规划框架，分析99种配额水平与可再生能源渗透率的组合情景，并对比总量匹配和逐时匹配两种配额方式。
AI.findings: （1）总量匹配下，可再生能能源蚕食可导致政策三重失败；（2）逐时匹配将悖论边界移动约5-11个百分点，但无法消除；（3）政策成功与失败的边界近似线性关系；（4）可再生能源容量未同步扩张时，绿氢配额可能适得其反。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并量化了集成能源系统中的“可再生能能源蚕食”机制和CO2悖论，揭示了绿氢配额政策的潜在反效果，拓展了可再生能源政策评估的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供预警：实施绿氢配额时需同步扩张可再生能源装机容量，否则可能适得其反；同时提示逐时匹配优于总量匹配，但不能完全解决问题。

title: Spatial Inequities in Food Environments: A Predictive Machine Learning Framework for Auditing Obesogenic Landscapes and Chronic Metabolic Health in the United States

detail.title: Spatial Inequities in Food Environments: A Predictive Machine Learning Framework for Auditing Obesogenic Landscapes and Chronic Metabolic Health in the United States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a high-granularity spatial and quantitative data auditing framework to investigate the structural correlation between regional food environments - specifically the prevalence of ‘food swamps’ and adult metabolic health outcomes across the United States. Integrating cross-sectional data from the USDA Food Environment Atlas and the CDC Branded Food Products Database, I engineered an explicit geographic metric: the Food Swamp Ratio (FSR). To overcome the non-linear limitations of traditional ordinary least squares (OLS) regressions, an optimized XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) machine learning model was deployed to isolate predictive features driving regional adult obesity and type 2 diabetes indices. The model identifies that a high FSR exerts a statistically superior predictive weight over standalone economic factors, such as median household income. The findings demonstrate that public health interventions targeting physical food infrastructure carry significant policy efficacy for systemic cost containment within federal healthcare frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于美国县级数据，构建了"食品沼泽比率"（FSR）指标，并利用XGBoost机器学习模型发现：高FSR对成人肥胖和2型糖尿病率的预测权重显著高于家庭收入中位数等传统经济因素，说明食品物理基础设施对代谢健康有独立且重要的影响。
AI.research_question: 区域食品环境（尤其是"食品沼泽"）的结构性特征与美国成人代谢健康结果之间存在怎样的统计关联？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注"食品荒漠"（缺乏健康食品的贫困区域），但对"食品沼泽"（不健康食品过度密集的区域）的关注不足；同时传统OLS回归无法捕捉食品环境与健康结果之间的非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食品环境与代谢健康的结构相关性理论；"食品沼泽"假说——即不健康食品零售店的过度密集比缺乏健康食品超市对肥胖和糖尿病的影响更为显著。
AI.method: 整合USDA食品环境地图集和CDC品牌食品数据库的横截面数据；构建"食品沼泽比率"（FSR）地理指标；采用XGBoost梯度提升机器学习模型替代传统OLS回归，用于预测特征的隔离与重要性排序。
AI.findings: 高FSR对区域成人肥胖率和2型糖尿病率具有统计上显著的预测权重，且该权重高于家庭收入中位数等单独经济因素；说明物理食品基础设施对代谢健康的影响独立于并超越经济因素的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"食品沼泽"概念操作化为可量化的FSR指标；通过机器学习验证了食品环境的结构性效应超越经济因素的独立解释力；为非线性的食品-健康关系提供了新的方法论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了明确的干预靶点——针对食品物理基础设施（如限制不健康食品零售密度）的干预措施在降低肥胖和糖尿病负担方面具有可量化的政策效能；有助于联邦医疗体系实现系统性成本控制。

title: The Tradability Filter: Endogenous No-Trade Bands and Executable Edge in Prediction Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Tradability Filter: Endogenous No-Trade Bands and Executable Edge in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: Prediction-market prices are often interpreted as direct probabilities of future events. This interpretation is useful for forecasting, but it is not equivalent to a trading opportunity. A probability-price gap becomes economically meaningful only if it survives execution prices, fees, bid-ask spreads, order-book depth, model uncertainty, settlement risk, adverse selection, and capital lock-up. This paper develops a theoretical framework for binary event contracts that separates forecast accuracy, expected value, and executable profit. I adapt the Glosten-Milgrom model to binary event contracts and derive closed-form competitive bid and ask quotes under informed order flow. The resulting adverse-selection spread is increasing in the share of informed flow and is largest for events near probability one half. The paper then distinguishes semantic event risk from settlement risk. When informed traders observe the semantic event while the contract settles on a noisy outcome, settlement ambiguity attenuates the adverse-selection component of the spread by the factor (1-delta_0-delta_1). Asymmetric settlement errors also shift the no-trade band: false-positive settlement risk raises it, while false-negative settlement risk lowers it. The framework formalizes when apparent prediction-market mispricing becomes tradable edge.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个二元事件合约的理论框架，区分了预测准确率、预期价值和可执行利润，揭示了预测市场价格并非直接等同于交易机会，需考虑执行价格、费用、买卖价差、订单簿深度、模型不确定性、结算风险和逆向选择等因素。
AI.research_question: 预测市场价格何时从概率预测转化为可执行的交易机会？
AI.motivation: 预测市场价格常被直接解读为未来事件的概率，但这种解读忽略了交易成本与市场摩擦，导致预测准确率与交易盈利之间存在鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: Glosten-Milgrom模型（适应于二元事件合约）；逆向选择价差；语义事件风险 vs 结算风险；无交易区间（no-trade band）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：在知情订单流条件下推导竞争性买卖报价的闭式解，分析逆向选择价差与结算误差的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 逆向选择价差随知情交易者比例上升而增加，在事件概率接近0.5时最大；(2) 结算模糊性通过因子(1-δ₀-δ₁)削弱逆向选择成分；(3) 非对称结算误差会移动无交易区间（假阳性提高区间，假阴性降低区间）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将Glosten-Milgrom框架应用于二元事件合约，区分了语义事件风险与结算风险，形式化了预测市场"错误定价"何时转化为可交易优势的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场参与者提供了识别真正交易机会的分析工具，帮助区分预测准确性与可执行盈利，指导交易者在考虑各种摩擦因素后做出决策。

title: Machine Learning and Dynamic Capabilities: A Qualitative Analysis of Resilience, Risk, and Sustainability in Taiwan's Semiconductor Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Plymouth and University of Plymouth

detail.title: Machine Learning and Dynamic Capabilities: A Qualitative Analysis of Resilience, Risk, and Sustainability in Taiwan's Semiconductor Supply Chains
detail.abstract: This study examines how machine learning (ML) enhances resilience, risk management, and sustainability within Taiwan's semiconductor supply chains (SSCs). Whilst existing research tends to address these dimensions in isolation, their interdependencies within complex, data-intensive production systems remain underexplored. Drawing on Dynamic Capabilities Theory (DCT) and qualitative data from eleven semi-structured interviews with industry professionals in Taiwan, this article investigates how ML is adopted, interpreted, and embedded within organisational routines. The findings reveal that ML functions as a dynamic capability amplifier, augmenting managerial cognition across sensing, seizing, and transforming processes rather than supplanting human judgement. Effectiveness is contingent upon data governance, infrastructural maturity, and cross-tier coordination. To synthesise these insights, the study develops the AI-Enhanced Semiconductor Supply Chain Framework (AI-SSCF), offering theoretical and practical guidance for responsible ML deployment. The article contributes to DCT scholarship by conceptualising cognitive hybridity as central to capability renewal in high-velocity industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨机器学习如何增强台湾半导体供应链的韧性、风险管理和可持续性，基于动态能力理论和11位行业专家的半结构化访谈，提出ML作为动态能力放大器，并构建了AI-SSCF框架。
AI.research_question: 机器学习如何在台湾半导体供应链中被采纳、解释和嵌入组织惯例，以增强韧性、风险管理和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将韧性、风险管理和可持续性视为独立维度，忽视了它们在复杂、数据密集型生产系统中的相互依赖关系，这一研究空白亟需填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（DCT），具体聚焦于感知、把握和转型三个核心过程。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过对台湾半导体行业11位专业人士进行半结构化访谈收集数据。
